title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Istanbul, Türkiye Shape a future with purpose at Arup in Istanbul Arup's purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. We are a global consultancy with extensive technical and advisory expertise. Our structural engineering team in Türkiye works at the intersection of engineering rigour and digital innovation, delivering complex, high-quality structures through integrated, multidisciplinary design. The Opportunity We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our Istanbul office to contribute our Mechanical Team for local and international projects. You'll play a key role in shaping sustainable built environments, collaborating with a talented team and working with prestigious clients. This role offers significant opportunities for professional growth and development within a global firm committed to innovation and positive social impact. As a Senior Mechanical Engineer At Arup, You Will Be involved in building services mechanical design activities, including HVAC, public health, and firefighting systems, across a broad range of building and project types. Work with several high-profile architects on a variety of prestigious projects in Türkiye and overseas. Prepare reports; including design reports, technical notes, and other project documentation. Develop your skills continuously, being responsible for preparing building services design documents within agreed timelines and to the highest quality standards. Design MEP systems for a wide range of building types and project requirements. Does this role inspire you? We’re looking for someone who is passionate about working on a variety of prestigious projects in Türkiye and overseas. Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from a reputable university. Excellent command of English, both written and spoken. Minimum 10 years of experience in HVAC design, building energy modelling, and sustainable building design. Knowledge and practical experience with Building Information Modelling (BIM) software such as Revit, Navisworks, Solibri, and MagiCAD. Experience performing energy analyses using advanced spreadsheets and building simulation software such as HAP, IES, eQUEST, and EnergyPlus. Knowledge or experience with parametric design and programming languages such as C# or Python is an advantage. Working knowledge of software including MS Office, HAP, TRACE 700, AutoCAD, REVIT or similar mechanical calculation and design tools. Experience designing in accordance with local and major international codes and standards. A strong understanding of fundamental engineering principles, together with a willingness to adapt and develop skills across a wide range of project types. Experience with Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is an advantage. Why Arup? At Arup, we believe in rewarding our members for their contributions to our shared success. As a trust-owned company, we have the freedom to pursue meaningful work that aligns with our purpose and values. We also offer a unique profit share program, allowing our members to share in the results of our collective efforts. Benefits That Work For You Professional Growth & Development: Benefit from continuous learning opportunities, training programs, and mentorship to enhance your skills and advance your career at Arup. Global Opportunities: Collaborate with colleagues worldwide and explore potential short-term or long-term assignments at other Arup offices and project locations. Financial Well-being & Ownership: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package and share in Arup's success through our global profit-sharing programme. Flexible working: Working from home up to 3 days a week and up to 20 days a year from another country. At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective where individuality is encouraged. Our strength comes from how we respect, share, and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. You'll have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, and to the clients and communities we serve. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of the world around us. We actively promote a culture of inclusion where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued. We welcome applications from talented individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible. If you need any assistance or adjustments, please visit our Candidate Support page for contact information and assistance. We're happy to help. Do you want to join us in shaping a better world? title: Process Quality Engineer
description: What You’ll Do The Senior Process Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality performance of manufacturing processes and internally produced components throughout the production lifecycle. The role leads process quality improvement activities, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, process risk assessments, quality planning, and quality system compliance. The position works closely with Production, Engineering and Supply Chain teams to reduce defects, improve process capability, and strengthen operational quality performance. The role also provides day-to-day guidance and supervision for a team of Quality Operators supporting manufacturing operations. Performing the quality controls and reportings for the parts manufactured in machinery,resine,silicon and sheet metal departments, Defining the control periods and creating the quality control plans and instructions for the parts manufactured in machinery,resine,silicon and sheet metal departments, Performing the controls (visual and dimensional controls), partial discharge tests and leakage tests for the parts manufactured in cast resin department, In case a fault occurs in the parts produced internally, communicating with the related department's manager and creating corrective and preventive action forms for the faults, Approving or rejecting and also reporting the first sample parts, Conducting the PPAP and PFMEA studies for the parts produced on-site, Contributing to A3 and 8D studies in the team. Lead process quality activities across manufacturing operations to ensure compliance with quality standards and customer requirements. Drive root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action implementation for internal non-conformities and customer complaints. Monitor process quality KPIs and identify improvement opportunities. Support PFMEA, Lead Control Plan and support process validation activities. Support APQP and new product introduction projects from a quality perspective. Lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve process capability and reduce quality losses. Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings. Provide daily supervision, coaching and performance guidance to 3 Quality Operators." Qualifications Bachelor's Degree on Mechanical Engineering - Metallurgical and Materials Engineering At least 5 years of experience in quality control Skills Strong knowledge of APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC and MSA methodologies. Experience with structured problem-solving tools such as 8D, A3 and Root Cause Analysis. Ability to interpret technical drawings and manufacturing specifications. Knowledge of ISO 9001 and quality management systems; IATF 16949 knowledge is considered an advantage." Being prone to teamwork, being available to come to the plant on weekends sometimes, Having intermediate level of English language skills

title: İHA Sistem Mühendisi
description: PAVO GROUP , teknolojik gelişmeleri sürekli takip eden, bu gelişmeleri ürün ve hizmetlerine yansıtarak öncü olmaya çalışan, kendisine ve çevresine değer katan, ekibiyle birlikte temel değerleri koruyan, tercih edilen işletme olma hedefiyle ilerlemektedir. Etik kurallarından, iş ahlakından ve dürüstlüğünden taviz vermeden pazarda ortak olmayı hedefleyen Pavo Group; Aviyonik Sistemler, Veri Merkezi & Altyapı Çözümleri, Katma Değerli Endüstriyel Yapılar ve Bilgi Teknolojileri, Yapay Zeka, Siber Güvenlik, Ethernet Çözümleri, savunma ve sivil sektörde sistem entegratörü olarak yerli ve yabancı stratejik ortaklarına sistem çözümleri sunmaktadır. İSTANBUL SAVUNMA SİSTEMLERİ (IDS) oyun değiştirici olabilecek niş ürünlerle Türkiye'nin savunma ihtiyaçlarının karşılanmasına katkı sağlamayı hedef alır. Tüm ihtiyaçlara cevap verebilecek esnek mimarilerle tasarladığı ürünlerin kullanım, bakım ve entegrasyonunun kolay olmasına özen gösterir. Aynı zamanda olası ürünleri hem sivil hem de askeri kullanım için hazırlamaktadır. Deneyimli kadrosu ile elektro-optik sistemleri geliştirerek çalışmalarına devam etmektedir. GÖREV VE SORUMLULUKLAR Sistem gereksinimleri, tasarım dokümanları, arayüz kontrol dokümanları ve doğrulama matrislerinin hazırlanması ve güncel tutulması. Gereksinim izlenebilirliğinin (Requirements Traceability) sağlanması. Sistem tasarım gözden geçirme faaliyetlerine (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR vb.) katılım sağlanması ve ilgili teknik çıktıların hazırlanması. Teknik değişikliklerin sistem seviyesindeki etkilerinin değerlendirilmesi. Proje kapsamında sistem mühendisliği faaliyetlerinin planlanması ve ilgili ekiplerle koordinasyonun sağlanması. Prototip geliştirme, sistem olgunlaştırma ve ürünleştirme süreçlerine teknik destek sağlanması. İHA, drone ve VTOL platformlarının sistem seviyesinde teknik mimarisinin oluşturulması ve geliştirilmesi. Operasyonel ihtiyaçların ve görev senaryolarının analiz edilerek sistem gereksinimlerine dönüştürülmesi. Sistem gereksinimlerinin alt sistemlere ayrıştırılması ve ilgili mühendislik disiplinlerine tahsis edilmesi. Sistem ve alt sistemler arasındaki fonksiyonel, elektriksel, mekanik ve haberleşme arayüzlerinin tanımlanması. Sistem tasarımında teknik alternatiflerin değerlendirilmesine ve tasarım kararlarının oluşturulmasına katkı sağlanması. Platform seviyesinde ağırlık, güç tüketimi, enerji bütçesi, faydalı yük kapasitesi ve uçuş süresi gibi kritik parametrelerin analizi. Uçuş kontrol sistemleri, otopilot, seyrüsefer, haberleşme, güç dağıtımı, tahrik sistemleri ve faydalı yüklerin sistem seviyesinde entegrasyonunun koordine edilmesi. Elektronik, mekanik, gömülü yazılım ve kontrol sistemleri ekipleri arasında teknik koordinasyonun sağlanması. Alt sistemler arasındaki arayüz uyumluluğunun değerlendirilmesi ve entegrasyon problemlerinin çözümlenmesi. Sistem seviyesinde teknik risklerin belirlenmesi ve risk azaltma faaliyetlerinin yürütülmesi. Alt sistem tedarikçilerinin teknik dokümanlarının, arayüzlerinin ve uygunluklarının değerlendirilmesi. GENEL NİTELİKLER Üniversitelerin Havacılık ve Uzay Mühendisliği, Uçak Mühendisliği, Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği, Mekatronik Mühendisliği, Kontrol ve Otomasyon Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun olmak. İHA, drone, VTOL veya benzeri elektromekanik sistemlerin geliştirilmesi alanında en az 3 yıl deneyim sahibi olmak. Multirotor, sabit kanat, hibrit VTOL veya elektrikli helikopter platformlarının geliştirilmesinde görev almış olmak. Sistem mühendisliği yaşam döngüsü, sistem mimarisi oluşturma ve gereksinim yönetimi konularında bilgi ve deneyime sahip olmak. Sistem, alt sistem ve bileşen seviyelerinde teknik gereksinimleri oluşturma, analiz etme ve yönetme süreçlerine hâkim olmak. Sistem gereksinimlerinin donanım, yazılım, mekanik ve kontrol sistemlerine ayrıştırılması konusunda deneyimli olmak. Sistem seviyesinde fonksiyonel mimari, fiziksel mimari ve arayüz tanımlama çalışmalarında görev almış olmak. INCOSE sistem mühendisliği yaklaşımı ve ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 standardı hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. Model Tabanlı Sistem Mühendisliği (MBSE) ve SysML konularında bilgi veya deneyim sahibi olmak. IBM DOORS veya benzeri sistem mühendisliği araçlarını kullanmış olmak. MATLAB/Simulink ortamında modelleme, analiz veya simülasyon deneyimine sahip olmak. FMEA, FMECA, FTA ve benzeri güvenilirlik ve emniyet analizleri konusunda bilgi sahibi olmak. Konfigürasyon yönetimi, değişiklik yönetimi ve teknik risk yönetimi süreçlerinde bilgilii olmak. Sistem entegrasyonu, doğrulama ve geçerleme (Verification & Validation – V&V) süreçleri hakkında bilgi ve deneyim sahibi olmak. Teknik dokümantasyon, sistem tasarım dokümanları, test prosedürleri ve test raporları hazırlama konusunda deneyimli olmak. Otonom görev sistemleri ve görev planlama yazılımları hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. İHA uçuş dinamiği, aerodinamik, stabilite ve kontrol konularında bilgi sahibi olmak. Elektrikli tahrik sistemleri, BLDC motorlar, ESC, batarya, BMS ve güç dağıtım sistemleri hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. İHA performans hesaplamaları, görev profili oluşturma, enerji bütçesi ve uçuş süresi analizleri konularında deneyimli olmak. İHA platformlarında ağırlık merkezi (CG), kütle dağılımı ve faydalı yük entegrasyonu konularında bilgi sahibi olmak. ArduPilot, PX4 veya benzeri otopilot sistemleriyle çalışma deneyimine sahip olmak. Mission Planner, QGroundControl veya benzeri yer kontrol yazılımlarını kullanmış olmak. GNSS, RTK, INS, IMU, manyetometre, barometre ve diğer seyrüsefer sensörlerinin çalışma prensipleri hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. MAVLink, CAN, UAVCAN/Cyphal, UART, RS-422, RS-485, Ethernet ve benzeri haberleşme protokolleri hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. İHA veri bağı (Data Link), telemetri ve komuta-kontrol (C2) sistemleri konusunda deneyimli olmak. Teknik dokümanları takip edebilecek, hazırlayabilecek ve uluslararası teknik toplantılara katılabilecek seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip olmak. TERCİH SEBEBİ MIL-STD-810 çevresel koşul testleri hakkında

title: Mechanical Design Engineer, Poultry
description: 🚀 We're Hiring: Mechanical Engineer Klaar voor een engineeringrol met échte impact? Ontwikkel geavanceerde machineoplossingen binnen een specialistisch team en bouw mee aan de volgende generatie food processing-technologie. 📍 Primaire locatie: Boxmeer 🕒 Employment Type: Full-Time, Hybrid 💼 Afdeling: Poultry - Mechanical Design Engineering 💥 Ontwerp technologie waar de rest van de markt naar kijkt. Ben jij een creatieve Mechanical Design Engineer die energie krijgt van het ontwerpen van slimme, innovatieve systemen? Wil jij werken aan high-tech oplossingen die wereldwijd bijdragen aan een efficiëntere en duurzamere voedselproductie? Dan hebben wij dé uitdaging voor jou! 🔍 Over de functie Als Mechanical Design Engineer ben jij de drijvende kracht achter de ontwikkeling van onze nieuwste generatie productiesystemen voor de pluimveevoedselverwerking . Van eerste concept tot productlancering – jij vertaalt ideeën en klantwensen naar robuuste, industriële oplossingen die het verschil maken op de productievloer. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s van Innovation, Supply Chain, Sales, Product Management en Service , en vormt zo de technische spil in een multidisciplinair team. Jouw ontwerpen zijn niet alleen slim en efficiënt, maar ook goed reinigbaar, onderhoudsvriendelijk en toekomstbestendig. 🧠 Wat ga je doen Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van innovatieve systemen en modules. Creatieve concepten omzetten naar concrete, maakbare ontwerpen. Realiseren van de gevraagde functionaliteit met hierbij o.a. aandacht voor: reinigbaarheidsaspecten, betrouwbaarheid, productietechnieken, veiligheid, duurzaamheid en kostprijs. Samenwerken met experts uit verschillende disciplines (Innovatie, productie, assemblage, sales en service) om innovatieve oplossingen te realiseren. Bijdragen aan (pre)-prototypes, 0-series, testen en productintroducties. Maken en documenteren van je ontwerpen en construeren in 3D CAD-pakket (Creo). Zorgdragen voor de oplevering van het documentatiepakket waarin alle engineeringsaspecten verwerkt zijn en de kennisoverdracht in de organisatie. Jouw impact Kortom, jij vertaalt technische ideeën naar robuuste, efficiënte en productieklare machines. Met jouw expertise draag je direct bij aan innovatieve oplossingen die JBT Marel helpen haar leidende positie in de pluimveeverwerkende industrie verder te versterken. 👤 Wat voor persoon ben jij Je bent een engineer die verder kijkt dan alleen het ontwerp. Je denkt mee over hoe machines slimmer, betrouwbaarder en efficiënter kunnen worden. Je krijgt energie van technische uitdagingen, werkt graag samen met andere specialisten en wilt bijdragen aan innovatieve oplossingen bij een wereldwijde marktleider in food processing. 🛠️ Wat neem je mee Je bent uiterste creatief en in staat om ideeën om te zetten in industriële oplossingen, zonder zakelijke aspecten uit het oog te verliezen. Je bent positief ingesteld, nieuwsgierig, leergierig en kritisch. Je analytische en numerieke vaardigheden zijn goed en je duikt graag in de materie. Daarnaast beschik je over uitstekende organisatorische vaardigheden en kan je prioriteiten stellen. Jouw Profiel Een creatieve en analytische engineer met een passie voor machinebouw. Bachelor- of Master diploma in Werktuigbouwkunde of Mechatronica. Bij voorkeur 3-5 jaar ervaring als Mechanical Design Engineer of vergelijkbaar Experience in the design of technical systems is desirable, preferably in the food industry Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met CAD- en tekensoftware, engineeringsdatabases en het opstellen van technische documentatie. Ervaring met systemen zoals Creo, Windchill en het werken volgens Model Based Design-principes is een pluspunt. Je denkt in oplossingen, niet in problemen. Ability to work independently, while being a team player The job requires the ability to travel occasionally (few times/year) on an as-needs basis Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband effectief werken. Incidenteel reizen (enkele keren per jaar) maakt onderdeel uit van de functie. 🏬 Werken bij JBT Marel Bij JBT Marel werk je aan technologie die écht impact maakt – in een cultuur die gericht is op samenwerking, respect en ontwikkeling. We houden van eenvoud, efficiëntie en denken in standaarden. In tegenstelling tot veel voedseltechnologie, bieden we naast constante innovatie op maat, en streven we naar slimme standaardoplossingen waar iedereen beter van wordt. Bij JBT Marel doen we werk dat ertoe doet. Wij geloven dat de inzet en groei van onze medewerkers direct bijdragen aan ons gezamenlijke succes. Onze missie is helder: de toekomst van voedsel transformeren . Dit is de basis van onze visie om dé toonaangevende partner te zijn in oplossingen voor een duurzame voedselindustrie. Samenwerking staat hierin centraal. We bouwen aan sterke relaties met klanten en collega’s door betrouwbare, complete oplossingen te bieden – van begin tot eind. Onze kernwaarden laten zien wie we willen zijn, elke dag weer: We werken met integriteit We creëren door samenwerking We groeien met vakmanschap We vernieuwen met lef 🌟 Wat kan je verwachten Wij investeren in jou – als professional én als mens. Of je nu bij ons komt werken aan een nieuwe uitdaging, wilt doorgroeien of je technische kennis wilt verdiepen: wij zorgen voor kansen die jou helpen het beste uit jezelf te halen. Niet alleen op je werk, maar ook thuis en in je omgeving. Je komt terecht in een hechte en inclusieve teamcultuur waarin internationale samenwerking centraal staat. Samen realiseren we projecten van wereldklasse. Bij ons leer je voortdurend bij, ontdek je nieuwe technologieën en blijf je groeien – op jouw tempo, met de juiste begeleiding. Maar ook Alle benodigde faciliteiten om je werk goed te kunnen doen, zoals een laptop, mobiele telefoon en een ingericht thuiskantoor. Een goede balans tussen werk en privé: 42 vakantiedagen, flexibele werktijden en mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken, jij kiest hoe je wilt werken! Een uitstekende pensioenregeling en mogelijkheid tot collectieve zorgverz

title: Mechanical Engineer / Tekenaar
description: Jij hebt technisch inzicht! Jij vindt afwisseling en kwaliteit belangrijk! Jij gaat voor klanttevredenheid! Dit ga je doen! Als Mechanical Engineer kom je te werken op onze engineeringafdeling, een hecht team van vier gedreven engineers. Samen zijn jullie de technische spil van het bedrijf. Je houdt je dagelijks bezig met: Het ontwikkelen, ontwerpen en doorrekenen van nieuwe maaimachines voor de landbouw, fruitteelt en wijnbouw. Het ontwerpen van klant specifieke maaimachines die perfect aansluiten bij de wensen van de internationale gebruiker. Het uitwerken van 3D-modellen en 2D productietekeningen (met Autodesk Inventor). Het uitvoeren van revisies en optimalisaties op bestaande ontwerpen. Uitgewerkte ontwerpen koppelen aan ons ERP productiesysteem (ISAH). Het meedenken over en optimaliseren van machines en ons productieproces. Technische ondersteuning bieden aan de afdelingen verkoop en productie. Jouw profiel! Jij bent gestructureerd, analytisch, zelfstandig en doelgericht. Je neemt initiatief en overlegt met collega's. Verder vragen wij: Je beschikt over HBO werk- en denkniveau. Je brengt een medior of senior profiel mee, met de nodige jaren relevante ervaring in de machinebouw. Ruime ervaring met 3D-modelleren en 2D-tekenen. Ervaring met bepalen van toleranties en lasaanduidingen in technische tekeningen. Je hebt een gedegen ervaring met het doorrekenen van constructies, onder meer met behulp van FEM-analyses (Nastran is een pré). Je hebt affiniteit en ervaring met productie(technieken) en zoekt actief naar afstemming met operators en monteurs. Je bent bereid om jezelf blijvend te ontwikkelen binnen het vakgebied. Iedereen is welkom bij Perfect van Wamel – wij zoeken de beste collega voor ons team! Ons aanbod! Een dynamische en afwisselende functie op onze locatie in Beneden-Leeuwen. Een marktconform salaris dat meegroeit met je opleiding, ervaring en kennis. Werktijden in dagdienst met uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden in overeenstemming met de CAO Metaal en Techniek! 38 vrije dagen (vakantie- en ATV- dagen) op fulltime basis. Dit zijn wij! Van Wamel kenmerkt zich door een werksfeer waarin de medewerker centraal staat. Van Wamel is fabrikant van PERFECT klepelmaaiers en cirkelmaaiers voor de land- en akkerbouw en de fruitteeltsector. Met een team van ongeveer 80 medewerkers worden deze machines in onze eigen fabriek ontworpen en gefabriceerd voor de professionele internationale gebruiker. Op dit moment bevinden wij ons in een boeiende transitiefase: we zijn onze engineering en productie aan het omvormen en reorganiseren naar de eisen van de 21ste eeuw om de internationale concurrentie succesvol het hoofd te blijven bieden. Toch behouden we altijd ons vertrouwde karakter: de sfeer bij Perfect van Wamel is en blijft informeel en familiair. Naast hard werken en de wekelijkse vrijdagmiddagborrel worden er met enige regelmaat activiteiten georganiseerd. Samen maken we het PERFECT! Enthousiast geworden? Graag ontvangen wij je CV en korte motivatie via de mail; hr@vanwamel.nl. Na ontvangst van je sollicitatie nemen wij binnen 5 werkdagen contact met je op. Voor meer informatie over deze functie kun je contact opnemen met Rob Gomes, Adviseur HR, bereikbaar op 06-82858571 (ook via Whatsapp) of via robgomes@vanwamel.nl Niet jouw functie? Maar wel interesse in Van Wamel? Voldoet de functie niet helemaal aan je wensen of voldoe je misschien niet helemaal aan het profiel maar heb je veel gevoel voor techniek, neem gerust eens contact met ons op. Je weet maar nooit!

title: Senior Design Engineer
description: SMST is een internationaal georiënteerde onderneming die innovatieve systemen bedenkt, ontwerpt en bouwt voor de offshore- en maritieme industrie. We leveren o.a. systemen voor het veilig overbrengen van personeel en vracht vanaf schepen naar offshore installaties. Onze focus ligt op renewable energy, met name offshore wind. Met trots kunnen we zeggen dat we marktleider zijn in mission equipment (gangway met toren en 3D-kraan), met de grootste geïnstalleerde basis ter wereld. Wat ons onderscheidt, is onze volledige in-house aanpak: van ontwerp tot productie, assemblage en testen tot wereldwijde installatie, service & customer support. Onze systemen zijn vooruitstrevend en continu in ontwikkeling. Vanuit Drachten gaan we voortdurend de technische uitdaging aan waarbij onze circa 180 medewerkers de ruimte krijgen om mee te groeien met ons succes. Wie wij zoeken? Voor ons multidisciplinaire engineeringsteam, bestaande uit circa 45 mechanische, hydraulische, elektrische en software engineers, zijn wij op zoek naar een: Senior Design Engineer (40 uur p/w) Zie jij uitdagingen om in dit multidisciplinaire team mee te werken aan het bedenken van oplossingen voor verschillende engineeringsvraagstukken binnen de offshore windenergie? Dan willen wij jou een leuke uitdaging bieden! Functieomschrijving Als ervaren Design Engineer ben je al vroeg betrokken bij het ontwerp van onze producten. Je werkt de productspecificaties uit in basis-en/of detailontwerp (onderbouwd met (hand)berekeningen) en kies je samen met het team de juiste (constructieve) oplossingen en aandrijfconcepten. Hierbij rekening houdend met SMST standaarden, eisen van de klant en eisen/voorschriften van certificerende instanties. Je maakt productietekeningen en stuklijsten of coördineert en/of controleert de aanmaak hiervan door derden. Je bent betrokken bij het ontwerp en de ontwikkelingen van onze producten. Je denkt en werkt mee aan de continue verbetering van bestaande functionaliteiten en producten en doet hiervoor onderbouwde verbetervoorstellen. Je draagt zorg voor de overdracht van tekeningenpakketten naar productie en denkt mee in oplossingen voor engineering vraagstukken die vanuit de productie komen. Functie eisen Je hebt een afgeronde opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde, Maritieme- of Civiele techniek op minimaal HBO-niveau of een WO opleiding; Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen de zware machinebouw, bij voorkeur in de offshore industrie; Je hebt ervaring op het gebied van mechanica, stijfheid & sterkteleer, aandrijftechniek en (methodisch) ontwerpen; Je hebt kennis van Inventor en Autocad. Kennis van Rstab of andere vergelijkbare rekenprogramma’s is een pré; Je hebt ervaring met hydrauliek; Je hebt kennis van productietechnieken; Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Engelse taal in woord en geschrift. Daarnaast beschik je over een aantal onmisbare persoonlijke eigenschappen zoals: Je hebt goede communicatieve eigenschappen; Je bent flexibel, je kunt goed omgaan met dynamische werkomstandigheden; Je bent pragmatisch, wat inhoudt dat je het werk ook vanuit praktisch oogpunt kunt bekijken; Je bent zelfstandig en proactief, jij gaat de uitdaging graag aan; Je bent nauwkeurig; Je bent resultaatgericht en wilt het werk graag goed afronden; Je bent nieuwsgierig en wilt graag met collega’s in gesprek; Je bent een teamspeler en werkt graag samen in multidisciplinaire teams. Werken bij SMST Werken bij SMST betekent werken bij een speler op wereldniveau in een bijzondere maakindustrie met uitmuntende kennis op hoog niveau. Bij ons staan techniek en creatieve oplossingen bovenaan. SMST heeft een informele en aangename werksfeer binnen een dynamische werkomgeving, wij houden van korte communicatielijnen. Bij SMST werk je niet alleen op abstract niveau aan producten, maar kom je letterlijk in aanraking met onze producten, omdat wij onze producten op dezelfde locatie produceren en testen. Wat kun je verwachten? We zijn graag transparant over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden. Hieronder een opsomming van de belangrijkste arbeidsvoorwaarden: Goed salaris, passend bij de functie; 38 vakantiedagen per jaar (op fulltime basis); Ruimte voor opleiding en trainingen; De mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken. Voor recruitmentbureaus geldt het volgende: wij nemen alleen kandidaten in behandeling van recruitmentbureaus die wij expliciet hebben gevraagd om mee te zoeken. Kandidaten die door andere recruitmentbureaus worden aangeboden worden niet door ons in behandeling genomen. Interested? Please fill out the application form below. Please add your letter and resume in Dutch or English. Je kunt je brief en CV in het Nederlands of Engels naar ons sturen.

Our ultimate aim is to provide increased value to both our customers and society. New, game-changing ideas and continuous improvement have been part of our DNA since 1834. We are now looking for a Mechanical Engineer, Thrusters to join the Thrusters Product Development team. Location: Drunen, The Netherlands. What will you be doing? You will be part of the Thrusters Product Development team, a dedicated team working on the development of new thruster products and the continuous improvement of the steerable thrusters, tunnel thrusters, retractable thrusters and underwater mountable thrusters in our product portfolio. As a Mechanical Engineer, you’ll be at the heart of the design and development process. From first concept to a manufacturing-ready technical solution, you will engineer parts, assemblies, and arrangements for our propulsion systems. You won’t do this alone: you’ll collaborate closely with lead engineers, fellow mechanical engineers, and technical experts across our offices in Drunen (NL), Helsinki (FI), Trieste (IT), and Wuxi (CN). What we offer: A collaborative environment - work with an experienced, international, and diverse team dedicated to advancing thruster technology. Provide technical support during development, manufacturing and commissioning to ensure successful delivery to our customers. Conduct feasibility studies and perform calculations to validate propulsion system designs. Modify and update existing designs to implement required changes and improvements. Report and present findings from designs, calculations, and analyses to project teams and stakeholders. Maintain and develop internal engineering guidelines and processes. Stay up to date with industry developments and engineering advancements relevant to propulsion systems. To be successful in this role, we expect you to have: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, or a related field. Experience in product development projects, or a strong willingness to develop skills in this area. Proficiency in 3D modelling, preferably using Siemens NX or another 3D CAD program. Experience in generating technical drawings and understanding manufacturing processes. A problem-solving mindset with an innovative and solution-oriented approach to challenges. Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal. Ability to work effectively in an international organization. A positive, proactive attitude, with eagerness to learn and adaptability. Teamwork skills, including flexibility and the ability to collaborate across disciplines. Knowledge of the maritime industry is an advantage. Why you and us? We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership and taking responsibility of our work. We support each other’s growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have courage to see opportunities and take initiative. We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe in a diverse and inclusive work community where everyone can be their true self. We don’t always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition? We have a skilled team embedded in a professional internal and external maritime community. You will be working in close cooperation with other teams within our Business Unit Propulsion. Such as Hydrodynamics, Technical Services, Supply Management, Innovation and Project Management. Contact & next steps We hope to hear from you soon, by submitting your application through our career portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout. At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities. This is Wärtsilä Wärtsilä Marine leads the industry in its journey towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. title: Wind Farm System Designer (Junior/Advanced Engineer)
description: Can you turn complex data into decisions that shape the future of offshore wind? At Vattenfall, there is a way. A way to accelerate the energy transition through innovation, collaboration and smart decision-making. As a Wind Farm System Designer, you will help define the design and value of some of Europe's largest offshore wind projects, influencing investment decisions worth billions of euros and contributing directly to a more sustainable energy system. Business Area Wind Within Business Area Wind, we develop, build and operate wind farms both onshore and offshore to accelerate the growth of renewable energy. We bring together international expertise, technological innovation and operational excellence to deliver world-class energy projects that support the transition to a more sustainable future. title: Engineer Intern
description: Company Description WaQment develops realistic, inert mine replicas used by military units, instructors, and professional training organizations to support mine awareness and counter-mine training. The company focuses on making high-quality training equipment more affordable, accessible, and scalable, helping defense and security professionals train more effectively. Using modern manufacturing methods, WaQment produces durable replicas designed for repeated field use, enabling realistic recognition, procedure, and decision-making training without live ordnance. The team works closely with instructors and end users to refine products and ensure they deliver genuine training value and operational relevance. Role Description As an Engineer Intern at WaQment, you will support the design, prototyping, and testing of training replicas and related equipment. On a typical day, you may assist with CAD modeling, help prepare and execute mechanical and field tests, document results, and contribute to improvements in materials, durability, and manufacturability. You will collaborate with engineers, production staff, and training specialists to translate user feedback into practical design changes and process enhancements. This is a temporary, on-site role based in Aarhus, where you will gain hands-on experience in product development, manufacturing methods, and defense training applications. Qualifications Enrollment in or recent completion of a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Design, or a related technical field. Foundational skills in engineering design and analysis and mechanical design principles. Interest in modern manufacturing methods (e.g., machining, injection molding, additive manufacturing) and willingness to learn hands-on production processes. Ability to assist with testing, data collection, and documentation, including basic measurement techniques and clear technical reporting. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to tasks in a workshop and lab environment. Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with engineers, instructors, and other stakeholders. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. title: EngD position: Flexure-joint Integrated Robust Elastic tripping mechanism
description: Job Description High-performance switching equipment requires mechanisms that operate quickly and reliably when needed. This project focuses on a safety-critical mechanism in which a compact actuator triggers a series of cascaded levers. The system must withstand loads in the kilonewton range and operate in a timespan of a few milliseconds. The challenge offers a rich combination of precision engineering, dynamics and robust mechanical design. Because such equipment may remain inactive for years, it must also operate reliably after long periods of standstill. The project explores whether compliant, flexure-based joints can provide a more predictable alternative to conventional interfaces by enabling motion through controlled elastic deformation. Candidates will have the opportunity to develop and validate innovative concepts that can contribute to a reliable future of dependable energy technology. Relying on advanced designs of flexure-joints, the applicability of mechanisms with such joints has been increased steadily over the past decades. Their operation with low friction, hysteresis and wear can offer highly predictable and robust performance. However, one of the remaining challenges are applications where the parts and hence also the flexure-joints are exposed to high loads. For reliable operation, the unwanted deformations of the joints should remain small whereas compliance for the intended motion should not be sacrificed. In this way, high accelerations can be realised to enable fast motion. The possible advantages are particularly evident when robustness has to be guaranteed in systems that should move reliably after being unused for a long time. Conventional sliding or rotation joints can stick, potentially compromising reliable operation. A more predictable and robust solution could be achieved by replacing conventional rotating bearings with flexure joints, which enable motion through elastic deformation and do not rely on sliding or rotating surfaces. Project objective The objective of this project is to investigate whether the conventional lever-based tripping mechanism can be replaced by a mechanism based on flexure joints. The proposed compliant mechanism must combine two challenging requirements: it must be capable of blocking motion under high loads, while also enabling an extremely fast release, preferably within several milliseconds. The investigation will combine numerical modelling and mechanical design with experimental validation. Several mechanism concepts will be analysed to assess their feasibility, followed by the development and testing of a promising concept in a hardware prototype. The project is structured into three design iterations: In the first phase (8 months) proposed mechanism concepts should demonstrate their ability to block the motion of a part while being subjected to a high force as well as showing a fast release. Numerical analyses support the design evaluation. Hardware test identify strengths and weaknesses of the concepts. The second phase (8 months) involves an iteration to use the lessons learned from the first design to design an improved concept. Furthermore, a larger range of operating conditions is considered, e.g. in terms of temperature range and vibrational loads. The third phase (8 months) aims towards a product related design of the compliant mechanism, which is also tested at the facilities of Siemens Energy. The assignment will be carried out at the University of Twente. The candidate should preferably have a solid background in mechanics of materials and precision design of mechanisms. The candidate should be able to collaborate with other members of the multidisciplinary research team at the UT, as well as with design and manufacturing engineers at Siemens Energy. Your profile We are searching for one of the best MSc graduate in the field of Precision Design or related discipline with a demonstrable affinity with multidisciplinary assignments. You can work in a team, You have good communication skills, You like to take initiative, You are fluent in spoken and written English. You have the ambition and talent to accelerate in finding solutions / creating designs for complex technological issues with a multidisciplinary character. Our offer A very challenging position fulltime position for two years in an inspiring multidisciplinary environment; A tailor-made post-master design program that has an educational component (50%) as well as a design project (50%); On successfully completing the program, you will receive a certified and recognized degree. You will be entitled to use the academic degree EngD and will be registered as a Technological Designer in the Dutch register kept by the Royal Institution of Engineers in the Netherlands (KIVI). A salary of € 3173 gross per month; An annual holiday allowance of 8% of the gross annual salary, and an annual year-end bonus of 8.3%; A solid pension scheme; Minimum of 29 leave days in case of full-time employment. A full Curriculum Vitae, including contact information for at least two academic references Transcripts from your Bachelor and/or Master degrees If you have any further questions about this vacancy or the EngD programme in Robotics, please contact dr. ir. R.G.K.M. Aarts and prof. dr. ir. D.M. Brouwer EngD (Email: r.g.k.m.aarts@utwente.nl and d.m.brouwer@utwente.nl) The first-round interviews will take place online in week 47 of 2026. Undertake parametric studies and develop AI-informed surrogate modelling approaches to support rapid prediction of structural performance. Depending on the role, you will focus either on customer-specific product configurations and modifications or on system-level layouts and 3D design. Both areas offer an exciting opportunity to develop your mechanical design skills while working with high-end technology and complex engineering systems. Interested? Keep reading! Your tasks will include mechanical design and engineering work for our cryogen-free dilution refrigerator systems, primarily using PTC Creo. In both roles, you will produce technical drawings and engineering documentation, maintain CAD data and documentation in PDM and ERP systems, and contribute to the development and improvement of engineering processes, tools, and documentation. You will also collaborate closely with different teams across the organization. In Layout Engineering , you will focus on creating and maintaining system layouts and 3D models. In Configuration Engineering , you will focus on customer-specific configurations and modifications of existing products. You will support the design of components and sub-systems, participate in engineering change projects, and create detailed manufacturing drawings. In Configuration Engineering , a good understanding of technical drawings, manufacturing, and assembly methods will help you succeed, as the role involves designing components and modifications that support customer-specific solutions. You will stand out if you have an independent and hands-on approach to work, enjoy collaborating with others, and communicate well with different stakeholders. Previous experience with PDM systems is also considered an advantage. Most importantly, we appreciate curiosity, a positive attitude, and a willingness to learn and develop your skills. In Layout Engineering , experience with large assemblies, system layouts, or similar 3D CAD design is beneficial. An interest in understanding how different components and sub-systems come together within a larger system will also help you succeed. In Configuration Engineering , previous experience with customer-specific mechanical design, manufacturing drawings, or engineering changes is an advantage. An understanding of how mechanical designs translate into manufacturing and assembly will also help you in the role. We offer you an interesting, challenging, and responsible position as well as the support of a highly skilled growth organization. title: Principal Engineer – Large Fabrications
description: Job Description Summary As the Principal Engineer – Large Fabrications, you will provide technical leadership and engineering rigor for the design, analysis, and validation of large fabricated and composite structures used in wind turbine nacelles and related assemblies. This role is focused on sheet-metal based structural components and requires deep expertise in structural integrity, dynamics, fatigue, fracture mechanics, strength assessment, and design for manufacturability. You will be responsible for driving robust engineering decisions through design reviews, drawing reviews, stack-up assessments, analytical calculations, and correlation of test and simulation results. You will also support review of certification activities, engage with external agencies as needed, and help strengthen technical capability across the organization, especially in dynamics. This is a leadership role for an experienced engineer who can challenge assumptions, develop new methods, and partner with CTHs, design teams, suppliers, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver safe, high-quality, and compliant products. Job Description Essential Responsibilities Lead the design, analysis, validation, and technical direction of large fabricated and composite structures for wind turbine nacelles. Drive robust engineering solutions for sheet-metal and composite structures, ensuring safety, quality, manufacturability, and compliance. Chair design reviews, perform detailed drawing and tolerance analyses, and ensure sound technical decisions throughout the product development process. Perform structural calculations and simulations in ANSYS, covering strength, frequency-domain fatigue, fracture mechanics, and structural performance. Apply industry standards (IIW, Eurocode, DNV) to support engineering decisions, compliance, and certification activities. Bridge testing and simulation by correlating results, improving models, and developing validated analysis methods. Partner with engineering leadership to strengthen structural engineering capabilities, identify technical gaps, and drive continuous improvement. Lead technical supplier reviews, root cause investigations, and cross-functional problem solving with design, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and certification teams. Support product lifecycle management (PLM) activities and mentor engineers to grow technical expertise across the team. Qualification / Requirements Master’s degree in Mechanical, Structural, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline. Extensive structural engineering experience, preferably with large fabricated metallic structures and composite components. Strong expertise in structural dynamics, sheet-metal fabrication, and composite structures. Hands-on experience in frequency-domain fatigue analysis, fracture mechanics, strength calculations, structural validation, and first-principles machine design. Proficiency in ANSYS or similar frequency-domain analysis tools. Working knowledge of engineering drawing reviews, GD&T, and tolerance stack-up analysis. Experience supporting certification processes and interacting with certification bodies. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and engineering coaching skills. Strong ownership, accountability, and commitment to engineering excellence. Desired Characteristics Knowledge of wind turbine nacelle structures and related design challenges. Familiarity with industry standards and codes such as IIW, Eurocode, and DNV. Demonstrated ability to lead technical reviews and make sound engineering decisions. Experience in test-to-simulation correlation and method development in frequency domain. Strong problem-solving skills with experience in RCA, supplier issue resolution, and technical investigations. Ability to challenge the status quo and drive technical advancement. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No

Advanced skills in CAD/PLM systems (UG NX, Teamcenter, SAP) and familiarity with CAE tools (FEA, CFD). Demonstrated ability to apply critical thinking, design thinking, and holistic problem-solving to complex engineering projects. Experience in supplier management, cross-functional collaboration, and technical negotiations. Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills with a global team mindset. Fluent in English (spoken and written).

title: Manufacturing Engineering Engineer
description: About the Company For over 100 years, Neapco has been a leading global provider of innovative driveline solutions for a wide variety of applications. Constantly evolving with changing markets and driveline technologies, Neapco provides leading-edge propshafts/driveshafts, sideshafts/halfshafts, differentials, aluminum die castings and driveline components to Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), driveline specialists and major heavy-duty parts distributors. Neapco’s capabilities feature a deeply experienced in-house engineering staff, automated lean manufacturing processes, and ongoing quality improvement. A trusted source of engineered solutions for all classes of vehicles and stationary driveline applications, Neapco is known industrywide for flexibility, innovation and on-time delivery. Neapco driveline products are used in commercial vehicles including over-the-road heavy trucks, busses, fire engines and light duty vans, as well as recreational vehicles (RVs) and large motor homes. Neapco provides a full line of fixed-length assemblies and many styles of yokes to interface with other driveline components. Neapco’s flexible engineering and production capabilities can deliver solutions ranging from short-run custom and standard configurations to high-volume OEM assemblies. Widely specified in all commercial vehicle applications, Neapco precision products provide competitively priced OEM quality and performance. About the Role The Manufacturing Engineering Engineer oversees the development and implementation of manufacturing processes which maintain proper product functionality as well as cost efficiency. Responsibilities Provide sustainability of the production performance and quality. Work closely with specialists and operators in the shopfloor to ensure the efficiency of the manufaturing lines. Manage daily Process Audits. Coordinate product and process launches using APQP procedures and principles. Ensure that the manufacturing process is established with equipment, tooling, and process controls that can meet customer, risk, and operation targets. Manage through direct reports, the implementation of the PM system and the maintenance and repair of new equipment and tooling and the related physical plant in those areas through launch up until Production assumes responsibility. Monitor and plan equipment and tooling capacity. Maintain environmental regulatory compliance. Take role in establishing a capital budget and expense budget for management approval. Ensure that the applicable standard practices are understood and applied. Maintain metrics on: equipment and tooling capacity utilization, regulatory conformance, launch conformance, process performance, process control, PM performance, and labour standards conformance. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering Minimum of three (3) years of Manufacturing Engineering experience in an automotive parts manufacturing environment. Required Skills Proficiency in English is a must. Knowledge and understanding of CI tools and approaches (lean manufacturing, Kaizen, Six Sigma, problem solving, Kanban, process mapping, etc.). Experience with IATF 16949. Experience with structured APQP process. Experience with AIAG VDA P-FMEA. Experience on FANUC and/or SIEMENS programming. Understanding and application of SPC/process control. AutoCAD and Minitab (or other statistical package). Please send us your application preferably in English if you believe that you are the right candidate. title: Material Purchasing and Process Engineer
description: About Us Itameks is one of the top three manufacturers in Europe of automotive interior floor components. As a supplier to 23 global OEM/OES brands, the company holds the IATF 16949 quality certification. Our headquarters are located in Seyrantepe, İstanbul, with production facilities in the Free Trade Zone in Tuzla, İstanbul, and a new global production site currently being established. The continuous growth of our company is driven by the performance and engagement of our employees. Our success is built on the personal development of each employee, our team spirit, and both individual and collective achievements. Our employees act in line with our company culture, take initiative, assume responsibility, and transform challenges into opportunities. Key Responsibilities Research and analyze the technical characteristics, application areas, and manufacturing process impacts of TPE, rubber, textile, and other main and critical raw materials. Support the definition of material specifications for new products, materials, and process requirements in coordination with relevant technical departments. Participate in the development of new and alternative raw materials in line with internal and external customer requirements and follow the process through to serial production. Research alternative materials and suppliers in domestic and international markets and support their technical and commercial evaluation. Collect quotations from suppliers and prepare comparative analyses based on price, technical suitability, quality, lead time, and cost criteria. Contribute to cost reduction and localization projects for existing and alternative materials. Support new supplier evaluation, sampling, technical approval, and implementation processes in coordination with relevant departments. Monitor market developments related to materials, technologies, suppliers, and pricing and prepare relevant analyses. Analyze TPE, rubber, and textile manufacturing processes, including process parameters, machinery and equipment, and material-process interactions. Participate in process improvement and optimization activities focusing on efficiency, quality, cost, and cycle time. Support root cause analysis and permanent corrective action activities for technical problems encountered in manufacturing processes. Contribute to continuous improvement, cost reduction, process standardization, Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and SMED activities. Support takt time, cycle time, lead time, and other relevant process and time analyses. Participate in efficiency improvement activities related to TPE, rubber, and textile production lines, machinery, and equipment. Support the technical evaluation of new machinery, equipment, molds, fixtures, and apparatus, including the identification of technical requirements and alternative suppliers. Research new technologies, machinery, equipment, materials, and manufacturing methods and contribute to technical and economic feasibility studies. Follow production trials during new product and material introduction processes and support the evaluation and improvement of process results. Prepare technical and commercial comparisons, feasibility studies, and cost analyses related to materials, suppliers, processes, and investments. Monitor assigned activities in accordance with project plans and the Masterplan and report progress and results. Work closely with Purchasing, Production, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to identify improvement opportunities across the entire process, from raw material sourcing to manufacturing. Recent graduate or preferably 0–2 years of professional experience. Good command of English. Strong interest in manufacturing, material technologies, technical purchasing, and production processes. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to evaluate technical and commercial data together. Strong numerical analysis and problem-solving skills. Cost, efficiency, and continuous improvement-oriented mindset. Willingness to work actively on the production floor and learn manufacturing processes hands-on. Strong research, reporting, and presentation skills. Strong communication, coordination, and negotiation skills. Proficiency in MS Office applications. Ability to work effectively in a team and collaborate across different functions. Willingness to research, learn, and adapt to new materials, technologies, and manufacturing methods.

title: Pump Field Service Engineer
description: Our world depends on rocks, minerals, metals and other raw materials – the building blocks of modern society. As an industry leader, Metso helps transform these essential materials to enable sustainable modern life. Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources. Join nearly 18,000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you’re supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration. This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible. Job posting end date: 10/09/2026 Pump field Service Engineer Introduction We are seeking a Pump field Service Engineer to join our Pump Sales team. You will be responsible for executing the yearly sales plan, covering aftermarket of Pumps, Hydrocyclone, Hoses and Valves. Your role involves generating new business opportunities and managing existing customer relationships and support on troubleshooting. You will play a crucial part in driving sales growth, ensuring exceptional customer service, and strengthening our market presence. This position is mainly located in Ankara. Team you belong to You will join a team of technical sales professionals who are passionate about delivering high-quality solutions to customers in the mining, aggregates, and industriay. We work closely with internal and external stakeholders, such as sales managers, customer service teams, and technical support specialists, ensuring seamless communication and effective sales execution. Our team culture is all about collaboration, customer-centricity, and technical excellence. What You’ll Do Execute the yearly sales plan, identifying new business opportunities and maximizing sales within the assigned territory. Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers at all organizational levels, particularly with maintenance teams, supervisors, and operators. Provide excellent customer service by responding to inquiries regarding pricing, delivery, product details, reliability improvement, spare parts optimization, wear life optimization, life time extension trials, root cause analysis and technical troubleshooting. Provide hands-on field support whenever necessary to assist customers in resolving operational and technical challenges. Collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement customer-specific sales strategies. Maintain a strong company image by demonstrating professionalism, in-depth product knowledge, and an understanding of customer needs. Act as a liaison between customers and internal teams, ensuring a smooth flow of communication. Ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies. Support customers in inventory management and spare parts planning to optimize equipment availability and minimize downtime. Travel extensively for client meetings, industry events, and on-site sales and technical support activities. Who you are! Must possess an engineering degree, technical qualification, vocational training, apprenticeship, or equivalent hands-on industry experience in mechanical, maintenance, industrial, or related fields. Preferably have 5-10 years of experience as Sales / Technical Support in a similar industry. Demonstrated knowledge of mechanical equipment, industrial machinery, maintenance practices, and mining or mineral processing operations. Strong problem-solving skills and a results-oriented mindset with excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Self-motivated, with strong organizational and time management abilities. Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally. Knowledge of business transactions, including costing, pricing, profit calculations, and contract terms. Demonstrated understanding of equipment performance, failure modes, reliability issues, and operational challenges within industrial or mining environments. Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills, with the ability to identify and implement practical solutions in the field. Must have a valid driver's license and exprienced driver. Prepared to work flexible work hours to meet deadlines when required What's In It For You An inspiring purpose - Enabling sustainable modern life. Minerals and metals are the backbone of essential functions in the modern world. However, there's a pressing need for more sustainable solutions to collect and process them. At Metso, you get to be part of transforming the industry and making a positive change. Wellbeing and safety - Benefit from occupational healthcare, generous benefits plan, mental well-being services and engagement surveys. Compensation and rewards - Global incentive program tied to business and performance targets, company car or commuting aid and meal benefits. We are currently at the early prototype stage , defining the architecture, selecting components and preparing the first physical system. title: Founding Engineer
description: Help us expand what AI agents can build. Limrun runs development tools and applications as cloud services that agents can use from wherever they run. We're hiring an engineer to build and scale that platform. The role You'll help decide what to build and own projects from design through ongoing maintenance. You'll also join the on-call rotation, investigate production incidents, and fix their causes. What you'll do • Build and launch new tools, features, and cloud services, including the Go services, APIs, and Kubernetes controllers behind them. • Reduce startup times, improve scheduling, and make better use of compute as demand grows. • Build and maintain the tenant isolation, access controls, and networking that protect customer workloads and data. • Automate host provisioning, upgrades, and recovery from failures. • Work with customers to understand their workflows and turn problems they encounter into better APIs, tooling, and product features. What we're looking for • You've built, operated, and scaled production cloud infrastructure, with responsibility for deployment, observability, and reliability. • You've written and maintained Go services in production and can reason about concurrent code. • You understand Kubernetes architecture and controller patterns well enough to build on them and debug their behavior. • You can investigate failures across application code, networking, and operating systems. • You've shipped production software or infrastructure using AI-assisted development. We care about your work and the responsibility you've taken for it more than titles or years of experience. Nice to have, not required • Experience with sandboxing, virtual machines, or managing Linux and macOS hosts. • Hands-on work with DNS, routing, proxies, tunnels, or private networking. • Experience building APIs, SDKs, CLIs, CI systems, or remote build tools. • Experience using or building AI agents for platform maintenance and production operations. • Familiarity with mobile development workflows using simulators and emulators. Why Limrun As an early engineer, you'll work directly with the founder to decide what Limrun builds next. Each new service can open up more development workflows to agents. You'll help establish how the engineering team works, with room to take on broader responsibilities as the company grows. We're a small team using AI to tackle big infrastructure problems. Limrun gives you room to explore how far AI can take your engineering work, test ideas, and see the results in systems that developers and agents depend on. What we offer • A hybrid role based in Istanbul. • Regular team offsites. • Company-covered work travel across Europe and the US. Apply Send us your resume or profile and a short note about an engineering project you're proud of. This could be: • A system or service you took from design to production. • A scaling, performance, or reliability problem you solved. • An operational improvement that reduced failures, manual work, or recovery time. Tell us what you personally owned, the decisions you made, and what improved. If AI contributed, tell us how you used it and checked the results. Links to code, projects, or technical writing are welcome where you can share them.

title: CDI - Ingénieure/Ingénieur Analyses dynamiques
description: Rejoignez ArianeGroup et contribuez à des projets d'exception en tant qu’Ingénieure/Ingénieur Analyses dynamiques 🌍Votre environnement de travail Vous intégrerez le département de la Propulsion Solide , au sein du service Analyses Aérodynamiques et Dynamiques . Vous aurez pour missions la modélisation du comportement dynamique des moteurs à propergol solide , en collaboration avec divers métiers d'un bureau d'étude et en interface avec des secteurs essais . 📈 Ce que ce poste peut vous apporter Collaboration avec des personnes expérimentées dans un domaine de haute technicité. Participation à des projets uniques sur des produits d’exception 🔍Vos missions Réaliser des études de caractérisation vibratoire et des analyses dynamiques de structures en utilisant des outils de calcul éléments finis (FEM). Développer et valider des modèles numériques pour simuler le comportement mécanique des systèmes sous différentes conditions de charge et environnementales. Interpréter les résultats d'analyse et formuler des recommandations pour l'optimisation de la conception et la réduction des risques. Préparer et exploiter des essais à feu sur propulseurs à propergol solide ou des vols. Rédiger des rapports d'analyse technique détaillés et présenter les résultats aux équipes de conception, d'ingénierie et de projet. Piloter des activités en sous-traitance. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodes et outils d'analyse dynamique. 🎯Profil recherché Formation : Diplômé(e) d'une formation de type Bac +5 / Ingénieur(e) généraliste ou mécanique. Expérience : Expérience demandée de 5 ans minimum en Analyses Dynamiques. Compétences techniques : Maîtrise des logiciels de calcul éléments finis (FEM) et idéalement Nastran, Maîtrise de la modélisation éléments finis, et idéalement en suivi d'essai vibratoires. Compétences en programmation demandées : Compétences en Python et/ou Fortran Solides connaissances en dynamique des structures et idéalement en acoustique, comportement des matériaux visco-élastique. Maîtrise de l’environnement UNIX Anglais courant demandé 👨‍🚀👩‍🚀Qualités personnelles Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale. Autonomie, rigueur et esprit d'équipe. Force de proposition et sens de l'innovation. Analyse du besoin et adaptabilité ℹ Informations pratiques Type de contrat : CDI – Cadre Forfait Jour Lieu : Site ArianeGroup Le Haillan (33). Déplacements : Occasionnels sur les sites girondins situés à Saint-Médard en Jalles. 💬 Mot du Manager "Rejoignez une équipe dynamique où vous travaillerez sur des produits rares et à grande technicité, accompagnés de leurs challenges quotidiens !" ⚠️ Important : Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de défense délivrée par le Ministère des Armées. Prêt(e) à vibrer au rythme de l'innovation et à mettre votre expertise au service de nos ambitions spatiales ? Postulez dès maintenant et venez construire l’avenir avec nous ! 🚀 Quelques mots sur le site de : Le Haillan Situé proche de la métropole Bordelaise, le site de Haillan regroupe plus de 1000 salariés travaillant sur des installations de pointe au service de nos activités défenses et civiles. A votre arrivée, vous aurez l'occasion de visiter certaines d'entre-elles. Le site dispose d'un restaurant d'entreprise d'installations sportives communes avec les autres sites aquitains et d'un CSE dynamique avec de nombreuses sections associatives et avantages associés. Les lancements assurés par Arianespace sont retransmis sur le site, un musée expliquant l'histoire d'Ariane et les spécificités des pièces produites au Haillan est aussi ouvert et en libre-accès. Le site se situe dans l'AeroParc de Bordeaux. L'arrêt "Ariane" des bus N°30 et 39 se situe en face du site. Un parking auto/moto sécurisé est également disponible pour tous les salariés. Dans le cadre des activités relatives à l’emploi proposé, vous serez amené(e) à accéder à un (ou des) site(s) relevant de la responsabilité d’ArianeGroup. A cette fin et dans le respect des articles R1332-22-1 et suivants du Code de la Défense, nous vous informons qu’une enquête administrative sera réalisée à notre demande par l’autorité administrative, afin de vérifier qu’aucun fait vous concernant n’est incompatible avec l’accès envisagé. title: NVH-Simulation (m/w/d)
description: Nicht jeder kann von sich behaupten, die Welt zu ernähren, aber es ist ein Teil unseres Alltags. Hinter allem, was wir für unsere Landwirtinnen und Landwirte tun, steht ein AGCO Team. Wir sind stolz darauf, innovative Ideen in die Tat umzusetzen und zu einer besseren und nachhaltigeren Welt beizutragen. Werden Sie noch heute Teil unseres außergewöhnlichen Teams! Ihr Beitrag Sie entwickeln Simulationsmodelle zur Analyse und Bewertung des Schwingungs- und Akustikverhaltens von Fahrzeugen Sie analysieren und optimieren Antriebsstränge, Kabinen und Gesamtfahrzeuge zur Verbesserung von Komfort und Qualität Sie erstellen und erweitern detaillierte Fahrzeugmodelle für den Einsatz über alle Phasen der Produktentwicklung hinweg Sie planen, begleiten und bewerten Versuche zur Modellvalidierung sowie zur Weiterentwicklung von Simulationsmethoden Sie arbeiten zusammen mit Entwicklungsbereichen, externen Partnern und Hochschulen, um innovative technische Lösungen voranzutreiben Ihre Erfahrungen und Kompetenzen Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Fahrzeugtechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung Vertiefte Kenntnisse in der Modellbildung sowie in der numerischen Simulation Erfahrung mit FEM-Software (z. B. Ansys) und MKS-Software (z. B. Wir legen Wert auf Inklusion und sind uns bewusst, welche Innovationskraft eine diverse Belegschaft für unsere Landwirte darstellt.
