title: Ingénieur Structure Subsea (F/H)
description: Rejoignez l'Aventure MYTTRA en tant qu'Ingénieur Structure Subsea (F/H) ! Vous êtes spécialisé(e) dans le calcul de structures Subsea / Offshore et souhaitez intervenir sur des études complexes combinant calcul par éléments finis et dimensionnement de structures métalliques ? MYTTRA recherche un Ingénieur Structure Subsea maîtrisant Abaqus et SACS pour intervenir sur des problématiques de calcul et de dimensionnement de structures sous-marines. 🔎 VOS MISSIONS : ✔️ Réaliser les calculs de structures Subsea Prendre en charge les études de dimensionnement et de justification mécanique de structures destinées à des environnements Offshore / Subsea. ✔️ Réaliser les analyses Modéliser et analyser les structures par éléments finis en réalisant notamment des calculs plaques et volumiques . ✔️ Dimensionner les structures Réaliser les études portant sur les structures tubulaires et structures en treillis . ✔️ Analyser les résultats de calcul Interpréter les résultats des simulations, identifier les zones critiques et contribuer à l’optimisation des solutions de conception. ✔️ Participer aux revues techniques Apporter votre expertise calcul aux différentes phases du projet et échanger avec les équipes d’ingénierie sur les choix de conception. ✔️ Produire la documentation technique Rédiger les notes de calcul, rapports d’analyse et documents de justification associés. 🧩 VOTRE PROFIL : ✅ Expérience indispensable : Vous disposez impérativement d’une expérience professionnelle dans les environnements Subsea / Offshore de minimum 3 ans . ✅ Compétences techniques indispensables : Calcul de structures Subsea / Offshore Calcul par éléments finis Calcul plaque Calcul volumique Structures tubulaires Structures treillis ✅ Qualités recherchées : Excellentes capacités d’analyse Rigueur dans les calculs Autonomie Esprit de synthèse Capacité à travailler avec des équipes d’ingénierie multidisciplinaires ✨ POURQUOI MYTTRA ? 🌴 28 CP/An 🌍 2 CP Associatifs/An 🎭 100€ de pass culturel/an 💰 Prime de fin d'année automatique allant jusqu'à 1500€ Brut 📈 Intéressement 🍽️ Ticket Restaurant (8€) sans condition d'ancienneté 🚗 Frais de déplacement incitatifs

title: Ingénieur Calcul Structures Métalliques H/F
description: Description du poste Développer vos compétences au sein d’une équipe humaine et dynamique, contribuer à des missions passionnantes permettant de prévenir et de maîtriser les risques, ça vous tente ? Apave recherche une-e Ingénieur(e) Calcul Structures Métalliques . Au sein de l’agence de Limonest (69), l’équipe technique assure un rôle majeur : permettre à nos clients d’exercer leur métier en toute sécurité et contribuer ainsi au développement du Groupe Apave au cœur des territoires. Concrètement, en quoi va consister votre quotidien ? Vous réaliserez des missions d’assistance technique avec rédaction de notes de calcul pour la plupart du temps. Vous serez aussi amené(e) à effectuer des vérifications tierce partie de notes de calculs. Vous Interviendrez Sur Divers Types De Structures Bâtiments en charpente métallique Structures supports (mâts, pylônes, stockage industriel) Equipements d’accès et de sécurité (Passerelles, plateformes de travail, garde-corps) Equipements de levage et de manutention (Potences, monorails, ponts roulants) De quoi vous permettre de travailler sur plusieurs règlementations et normes et ainsi de monter en compétences sur plusieurs sujets techniques. Vos Principales Missions Seront Echange avec le client afin de définir son besoin et la faisabilité du projet Définir le prix et le contenu de la prestation avec rédaction d’une proposition commerciale Effectuer la prestation avec un accompagnement du client dans le cadre de son projet Vous l’aurez compris, vous serez acteur de votre affaire depuis le contact avec le client jusqu’à la réalisation de la prestation, et serez identifié par le client pour de futurs projets. Il est prévu un accompagnement complet lors de vos premières missions, avec en support des ingénieurs expérimentés dans le domaine de la structure, du levage et du nucléaire. Des déplacements ponctuels sont à prévoir sur certains projets, afin d’effectuer des expertises et / ou relevés dimensionnels de structures. Vous serez emmené à travailler sur des affaires de grande envergure (Nucléaire, International). Choisissez-nous ! En rejoignant Apave, vous intégrez plus qu'un groupe : vous prenez part à une histoire où la force du collectif est une réalité, où la notion d'accompagnement s'exprime au quotidien, pour que chacun trouve naturellement sa place. Parce que chez Apave, nous considérons nos différences comme une richesse que nous mettons chaque jour au service de missions à forte utilité sociale. Profil recherché Parlons de vous ! D’abord, Votre Cursus Vous êtes de formation Ingénieur(e) ou Master 2 Génie Civil ou Mécanique à dominante études de structures Vous avez de bonnes connaissances en Résistance de Matériaux Vous maîtrisez l’outil informatique et connaissez les logiciels de dimensionnement à barres et éléments finis de type ROBOT ou Advance Design, ainsi qu’Excel, Vous savez utiliser le logiciel ANSYS pour modéliser et analyser des structures métalliques plus complexes (ponts roulants, équipements de manutention ou de levage) Idéalement, vous maitrisez au moins un ou plusieurs codes de construction de structure métallique (CM66, normes EUROCODE 3 et règles de calculs FEM / NF EN 13001). Ensuite, Vos Compétences, Vos Qualités Personnelles Vous souhaitez monter en compétences sur la structure métallique au sein d’une équipe composés d’ingénieurs expérimentés et pouvant vous accompagner Vous aspirez à développer votre potentiel dans le domaine de la Structure Métallique, Rigoureux, autonome, doté d’un bon esprit d’analyse et d’un bon relationnel, Vous souhaitez travailler et vous investir sur des projets complexes et de grande technicité. Cette description correspond à votre profil ? Nous sommes faits pour nous entendre ! À partir de maintenant, comment ça se passe ? Faites-vous connaître. Postulez. Vous avez attiré notre curiosité ? Nous vous contactons pour un 1er échange. Nous souhaitons poursuivre ensemble ? Des entretiens opérationnels techniques et RH vous attendent. Bienvenue ! Notre collaboration va commencer, hâte de vous retrouver ! Nous Rejoindre, C'est Prendre du plaisir dans le travail et développer votre carrière. Nous vous proposons une diversité de missions loin de la routine, un programme de formation complet tout au long de votre parcours, et des possibilités de mobilité interne au sein du Groupe Une entreprise engagée dans votre équilibre vie professionnelle / vie personnelle : Droit à la déconnexion, Interventions majoritairement sur un secteur géographique défini. Bénéficier des avantages : 13ème mois, forfait repas ou ticket restaurant selon conditions de déplacement, RTT, participation / intéressement, plan d'épargne, prime vacances. Des outils connectés et de mobilité pour réaliser votre activité : smartphone, tablette.

title: Ingenjör inom Additiv tillverkning
description: BAE Systems Hägglunds AB Vill du arbeta inom försvarsindustrin och dessutom för en världsledande fordonstillverkare? Just nu befinner sig BAE Systems Hägglunds AB i en expansiv fas inom samtliga produktområden, då efterfrågan på Hägglunds fordon (Bandvagn / BVS10 och Stridsfordon 90 / CV90) nått höjder som aldrig tidigare har skådats. Är du redo att ta klivet in i framtidens teknik? Vi söker nu en Ingenjör inom Additive Manufacturing, AM. Var med och forma framtidens industri! Din framtida utmaning Additive Manufacturing – Framtidens Teknik och Innovation! Är du en passionerad och driven ingenjör som vill vara med och forma framtidens teknik? Som Ingenjör inom AM kommer du att spela en central roll i utvecklingen och effektiviseringen av vår additiva tillverkning. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med den senaste teknologin inom 3D-printing och ingå i hela designprocessen för att skapa innovativa lösningar. Som Ingenjör inom AM har du en tongivande roll i att utveckla och optimera våra teknologiska lösningar inom additiv tillverkning. Du kommer att arbeta nära vårt designteam, där du kommer att driva hela designprocessen från idé till färdig produkt. Din erfarenhet inom konstruktion, hållfasthet och programmering kommer vara avgörande för att säkerställa att alla projekt uppfyller våra höga krav på kvalitet och effektivitet. En spännande och framtidsinriktad arbetsmiljö där innovation och teknik står i fokus. Möjligheten att arbeta med den senaste teknologin inom additiv tillverkning. En roll där du verkligen kan påverka och forma utvecklingen av nya lösningar. Stöd från ett kompetent team och en stark kultur av samarbete och lärande. En dynamisk arbetsplats där effektivisering och utveckling är nyckelkomponenter i vår strategi. Den du är Konstruktionskompetens Förståelse för materialens hållfasthet Är van vid att arbeta med programmering och koder för att optimera designen för 3D-printing. Kunskap inom CNC och maskinbearbetning värderas högt Du kan arbeta inom etablerade riktlinjer och processer, samtidigt som du driver innovation och effektivisering i hela designflödet. Vill vara med och utveckla nästa generations 3D-printers och applicera teknologin för att lösa framtidens utmaningar. Flytande i svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift Vad du blir en del av Hos oss kommer du att ha kul på jobbet och ingen dag kommer att vara den andra lik! Du kommer att få vara med när produkten blir till från idé till dess att den rullar ut till kund. Du kommer att få jobba med framtidens teknik i ett globalt företag där du har stora möjligheter till kompetens & karriärutveckling. Om du inte kan se filmen, klicka på länken: https://youtu.be/sbvv-Jm2PhI BAE Systems levererar några av världens mest avancerade, teknikledande lösningar inom försvar, flyg och säkerhet. Vi har över 100 000 kvalificerade medarbetare i mer än 40 länder. Genom att vi arbetar tillsammans med kunder och lokala partners, levererar vi produkter och tjänster med militär kapacitet, som skyddar människor och den nationella säkerheten samt säkrar viktig information och infrastruktur. BAE Systems Hägglunds fokuserar på utveckling, tillverkning, integration och support av ett brett spektrum av militära fordon till kunder över hela världen. Våra främsta produkter är medeltunga stridsfordon (CV90), bepansrade terrängfordon (BvS10), stöd och support samt elhybrida drivsystem för den civila marknaden. Pålitlig, Innovativ och Djärv är ledorden för vår verksamhet. Läs gärna mer om Örnsköldsvik och Höga Kusten på www.jobbaochlev.se/ - www.inspiration.ornskoldsvik.se - www.hogakusten.com/sv Kontaktperson Har du frågor, är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig till Head of Standard Vehicle Variants Jimmy Blixt , 072 – 704 87 52 eller rekryteringskonsult Maria Josefsson 070 – 842 23 35. Sista ansökningsdag är den 6 december. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placeringsort Örnsköldsvik. Självklart erbjuder vi flyttbidrag om du flyttar för jobb hos oss. Vi arbetar med försvarssekretess, vilket innebär både legala krav samt speciella krav från våra kunder på oss som företag. Alla som anställs ska därför genomgå säkerhetskontroll och drogtest. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: PhD Position Unravelling Hydrogen-Induced Degradation and Fracture in Circular Steels
description: Join a cutting-edge research programme at TU Delft and investigate the mechanisms of hydrogen-induced degradation in circular steels. Job Description Within this project, you will investigate one of the key challenges facing the hydrogen economy: understanding how hydrogen interacts with the complex microstructures of circular steels and causes degradation and failure. This position is part of the project "Circularity as Opportunity: Engineering Hydrogen-Resistant Circular Steels (CIRHY)", a 6-year research and innovation programme developing next-generation circular steels that can safely operate in hydrogen environments. By combining advanced experiments with multiscale modelling, CIRHY aims to enable reliable and sustainable steels for future hydrogen infrastructure and industry. Hydrogen embrittlement is one of the major barriers to the safe deployment of hydrogen technologies. At the same time, increasing steel circularity introduces microstructural complexity through tramp elements, precipitates, inclusions and segregation phenomena. While considerable progress has been made in understanding hydrogen embrittlement in conventional steels, the mechanisms governing hydrogen-induced degradation and fracture in compositionally complex circular steels remain poorly understood. The Extreme Materials and Mechanics Group at TU Delft, led by Prof. Vera Popovich, is internationally recognized for its expertise in hydrogen embrittlement, fracture mechanics and advanced characterization of metallic materials. By combining state-of-the-art microscopy, hydrogen testing and fracture mechanics, the group develops fundamental understanding of material degradation in extreme environments and translates this knowledge into solutions for the energy transition. Within this position, you will combine advanced microstructural characterization, in-situ hydrogen mechanical testing and fracture toughness experiments to uncover how hydrogen interacts with circular steel microstructures and affects deformation, ductility, crack initiation and crack propagation. You will investigate hydrogen trapping and transport, identify the microstructural features controlling embrittlement and establish quantitative links between microstructure and structural performance. The outcome of this research, conducted in close collaboration with Tata Steel and other partners, will provide crucial experimental insights for designing safer and more reliable hydrogen-resistant circular steels. Role In this role, you will develop fundamental insights into the mechanisms governing hydrogen-induced degradation and failure of circular steels. As a PhD researcher, you will: Perform advanced 3D microstructural characterization of circular steels, focusing on segregation of tramp elements to precipitates, inclusions, interfaces, voids and dislocations. Investigate the influence of hydrogen on deformation behaviour and ductility through in-situ hydrogen mechanical testing. Quantify hydrogen transport, trapping and interaction with microstructural defects using advanced characterization techniques. Conduct in-situ hydrogen fracture toughness testing to identify crack initiation and propagation mechanisms. Collaborate closely with researchers from the Department of Materials Science and Engineering at TU Delft, University of Groningen, Eindhoven University of Technology, University of Twente, KU Leuven, MPI for Sustainable Materials and multiple industrial partners. Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations and dissemination activities within the M2i framework. Job Requirements We are looking for a highly motivated and curious researcher with a strong interest in materials degradation, hydrogen embrittlement and advanced experimental characterization. You enjoy working at the intersection of materials science, mechanics and microscopy, and are excited to contribute to the development of sustainable materials for the hydrogen economy. You are an independent thinker, eager to learn new experimental techniques, and enjoy collaborating with researchers from different disciplines as well as industrial partners. Furthermore, You Meet The Following Requirements You hold a Master's degree in Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Applied Physics, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline. You have a strong background in physical metallurgy, materials characterization, fracture mechanics, mechanical behaviour of materials, or a related field. Experience with one or more advanced characterization techniques such as SEM, EBSD, TEM, XRD, SIMS or related methods is highly desirable. Experience with mechanical testing, fracture mechanics, hydrogen embrittlement research or materials degradation is an advantage but not mandatory. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and enjoy combining experimental observations with scientific interpretation. You have a strong academic track record, demonstrated by excellent study results and/or research experience. You are enthusiastic about working in a multidisciplinary academic and industrial consortium. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Our alumni turn knowledge into concrete solutions for the challenges of today and tomorrow. These challenges are changing rapidly. Monitor energy consumption of HVAC and utility systems; develop energy efficiency and optimization projects. Manage and supervise the work of third-party service and maintenance contractors. Visit our website for more info: www.OneSec.com Role Overview OneSec has developed an experimental drone that can beat the world record for longest ever drone flight. ODTÜ Teknokent ofisimize, havacılık yakıt ve yağlama ekipmanları başta olmak üzere, elektro-mekanik alt sistemlerin, gereksinimden doğrulamaya kadar uzanan ürün geliştirme süreçlerine liderlik edecek, çalışma arkadaşları arıyoruz. İş Tanımı • Üst seviye sistem gereksinimlerini alt seviye mekanik tasarım gereksinimlerine dönüştürmek, tasarıma eksiksiz aktarmak ve doğrulama aşamasına kadar izlenebilirliğini sağlamak. • Literatür, standart ve pazar araştırmalarını yürüterek kavramsal tasarım, teknoloji geliştirme, prototipleme ve tasarım olgunlaştırma faaliyetlerini gerçekleştirmek. • İleri seviye 3B modelleme, 2B teknik resim hazırlama, Geometrik Ölçümlendirme ve Toleranslandırma (GD&T) ile tolerans yığılım (stack-up) analizlerini yürütmek. • Üretim ekipleriyle koordineli çalışarak Üretilebilirlik) ve Montajlanabilirlik değerlendirmelerini yapmak; tasarımları performans, güvenilirlik, ağırlık, maliyet ve çevrim süresi ekseninde optimize etmek. • Yapısal, akış ve termal analizlerin gerçekleştirilmesi amacı ile analiz ekipleriyle gerekli girdi ve çıktıların belirlenmesinde rol almak, analiz çıktıları mekanik tasarıma yansıtmak. • Çevresel ve fonksiyonel tasarım doğrulama testlerini test ekipleriyle birlikte yürütmek; testlerde gözlenen uyumsuzlukların kök neden analizlerini (RCA) yaparak tasarım düzeltici faaliyetlerini sonuçlandırmak. • Ürün Ağacı (BOM), Arayüz Kontrol Dokümanı (ICD), malzeme tanımları, montaj talimatları ve tasarım doğrulama raporlarını hazırlamak ve güncelliğini sağlamak. • Tasarım ve değişiklik yönetim süreçlerini kurumsal konfigürasyon, kalite standartları ve havacılık prosedürlerine uygun yürütmek. • Sistem, analiz, test, üretim, kalite, tedarik zinciri ve alt yükleniciler arasındaki teknik koordinasyonu sağlamak; iç ve dış paydaşlara teknik sunumlar gerçekleştirmek. An engineering division was created at the beginning of 2025 to expand our services to our clients on each and every project. We are seeking to further expand our team of engineers and BIM modelers to tackle mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, and civil aspects of a wide range of projects spanning from retail, restaurant, grocery and refrigeration, and commercial buildings to heavy industrial, data centers and even hospitality. This position will initially focus on supporting a dedicated engineering team for a major US grocery and retail client, providing modeling, drafting, calculation, and coordination support for that client's refrigeration engineering group. As demand grows and skills develop, team members will have the opportunity to flex into other engineering assignments across Trelity's broader project base. This position sets the stage for career advancement as we are finding a high demand for these services. This person will be working with and learning directly from the Engineering Manager as well as several peers with an extensive range of backgrounds and experiences. This position will require flexibility and adaptability as we seek to address our clients’ wide-ranging requests and grow our capabilities project by project. This role includes structured, hands on mentorship in refrigeration engineering from experienced US based client engineers, in addition to Trelity's internal training and support. Job Description: Lead mechanical HVAC and plumbing modeling and construction drawing development efforts in both AutoCAD and/or Revit based on direction provided by client and Engineering Manager. Perform basic mechanical HVAC and plumbing calculations in accordance with US code requirements and guidance from supervisors. Support refrigeration system design efforts, including modeling, drafting, and coordination of refrigeration equipment layouts, piping, and line sizing, under the direction of client refrigeration engineers and Trelity leadership. Coordinate mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and structural information between the refrigeration team and other disciplines to support accurate and well coordinated project delivery. Learn refrigeration codes, terminology, and industry standard practices through structured mentorship from US based client engineers and Trelity's senior technical staff. Understand and apply company-wide QAQC controls and standards. Prepare basic reports, specifications, and simple system designs. Research code compliance requirements specific to the project locations and advise on project adherence to these codes. Manage time spent completing project deliverables within prescribed budget and schedule. Effectively manage all assigned projects according to their Project Brief scope. Meet all “Expectations” listed below. Essential Expectations: Fulfill our brand promises: High Quality, On Time In Full, No Surprises, Good Design Judgement Essential Qualifications: University degree in Engineering. 1+ years AEC industry experience; refrigeration specific experience is not required. Strong Autodesk Revit/AutoCAD experience. Strong experience with MS Office programs. Experience in performance of analysis and design calculations of HVAC and plumbing systems is preferable. Eagerness to learn refrigeration engineering fundamentals through direct mentorship from experienced US based client engineers, valued more than prior project leadership experience. Interest in managing people, projects, and client communication. Fluent in English at C1 level, able to communicate comfortably with clients based in the USA, both in understanding and verbally expressing ideas. Key Attributes: Patient with repetitive work. High quality focus & detail orientation. Desire to grow as a person and professional. Questioning attitude, seeks understanding. Open to supporting questions/needs that come from team members. Ambitious, Collaborative, Persistent. Values align with our Core Values. Comfortable receiving close, ongoing mentorship from client side engineers, and adaptable enough to move between refrigeration focused work and other project types as assignments shift. Growth Paths: This is an internal position at izURET and we expect that the next steps from this role will be becoming: Mechanical Associate Coordinator – if you love mechanical engineering/design and wish to lead, develop, and train other mechanical associates, this could be your next step. Engineering Program Coordinator – if you like management and coordinating the flow of information to a diverse team, structuring their time and resources to achieve a shared goal, this could be your next step. Refrigeration Design Lead: if you want to deepen your specialization in refrigeration engineering and help grow this practice area, this could be your next step.

title: Sr. R&D Engineer
description: Our Story Pointr is the market leader in Indoor Mapping, Location and Analytics, and the inventor of AI-based map production. Its innovative (20+ patents) Pointr Maps™ platform is used by millions of users across offices, retail locations, airports, hospitals, and more every month. As the top choice of Fortune 100 customers and billions of sqft. deployed globally (30+ countries), Pointr is always on the lookout for great team members to support its fast growth. Our core values are Ownership , Harmony , and Scale , and we look for Passionate, Kind, and No-Ego team members to join the team. Role Overview We're looking for a Sr. R&D Engineer to join the Location team and improve the positioning engine behind Pointr's blue dot offering, used in airports, hospitals, and corporate campuses. The engine turns noisy real-world sensor data into a reliable location estimate, indoors and outdoors. It runs primarily on iOS and Android, with the shared C++ core also supporting WebAssembly and backend services. You will take algorithm improvements from research through implementation, validation on real venue data, and release. The work spans probabilistic estimation, sensor fusion, and applied geometry, including the native mobile scanning code that supplies the engine's measurements. You'll join a small, senior team with ownership over technical decisions and a short path from experiments to customer deployments. What You'll Do Improve the accuracy, responsiveness, and robustness of Pointr's indoor-outdoor positioning algorithms across a wide range of venue types, devices, and real-world conditions. Research, develop, and evaluate positioning algorithms, spanning classical estimation and machine learning approaches, and measure whether they improve results on real venue data. Research and investigate emerging positioning technologies. Some work involves development kits, reference hardware, and measurement setups for capabilities not yet available on shipping phones. Build and use offline replay, accuracy regression suites, and simulation tools to measure improvements. Validate on real iOS and Android devices, where sensor behavior and runtime constraints can differ from desktop results. Develop production code in the shared C++ engine and the native iOS and Android sensor and radio scanning layers, with attention to performance, memory use, thread safety, and test coverage. Turn field issues, such as suboptimal hardware deployments or unexpected sensor behavior, into reproducible test cases and engine improvements. Use AI coding agents daily for research and development, and take responsibility for reviewing and validating their output. Shape technical decisions through experiments and code review. Document the reasoning behind your work and contribute invention disclosures where warranted. What Success Looks Like First 90 days: independently run and interpret the accuracy measurement tools, and ship your first engine improvement with tests and on-device validation. 6 months: own a significant area of the engine, deliver measurable positioning improvements, and diagnose field issues from customer venues. 12 months: set technical direction and measurement standards for your area, with improvements deployed at customer scale. Help the team develop and validate algorithms more effectively through reviews and better tooling. What We Seek 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including performance-sensitive production code. Depth in algorithms and estimation matters more than your current programming language; prior C++ experience is preferred, not required. Strong grounding in probabilistic state estimation and sensor fusion, including recursive Bayesian filtering and particle-based methods, with the judgment to choose an approach suited to the problem. Solid applied mathematics, including linear algebra, probability, numerical methods, and geometry. You can distinguish model limitations from data quality problems. Experience working with noisy, real-world sensor time series: reproducing issues from recorded traces, isolating causes, and validating changes with measurable results and automated tests. Daily use of AI coding agents and a basic understanding of how they work, including context windows, tool use, prompting, instruction files, and common failure modes. You can direct agents effectively and critically review their output. Working knowledge of iOS or Android development, enough to build and debug on real devices and modify native platform code. Comfort with native development tools, including build systems, Git, compilers, sanitizers, and profilers, and with cross-platform constraints. Clear technical communication with engineers and non-engineers, and a collaborative approach to technical disagreements and code review. Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken. Preferred Qualifications Experience in indoor positioning, GNSS, robotics, SLAM, pedestrian dead reckoning, or RF signal processing. Hands-on experience with Claude Code or OpenAI Codex; other AI coding agents also qualify. Experience building agent tools or integrations is a plus. Experience with modern C++, Swift, or Kotlin, or shipping a shared native core in iOS and Android apps. Familiarity with mobile constraints that affect positioning, including background execution, sensor and radio scanning APIs, power budgets, and device differences. Knowledge of ranging and positioning methods used with radio technologies such as BLE, UWB, or Wi-Fi. Experience with computational geometry, geospatial data, or map processing. Wayfinding and graph algorithms are useful secondary skills. Experience applying machine learning to motion or signal models, with evidence that it improves on classical estimation methods. Experience building simulation or visualization tools for algorithm development. An MS or PhD in a relevant field, research publications, or equivalent demonstrated depth in positioning, estimation,

description: Position Purpose At GAMA Enerji, we are looking for a motivated professional to join our Asset Performance & Modelling team and enhance the operational performance of our assets. Preparing regular analyses and reports on market prices, power plant performance, and model outputs; developing automated reporting solutions integrated with company systems using Power BI or similar business intelligence tools, Contributing to the development of data infrastructure and digitalization initiatives in coordination with the IT team; supporting data collection, processing and the integration of models and reports into company systems and business processes, to ensure their the effective and sustainable use. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline, preferably from a reputable university, 1–3 years of relevant experience in electricity markets, energy trading, power generation operations, or data analytics, Fluency in Turkish and English, written and spoken. title: Grid Connection & Modelling Engineer
description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Grid Connection & Modelling Engineer, you will develop and validate electrical simulation models for wind turbines and renewable energy power plants, ensuring compliance with grid code requirements and project commitments. You will perform power system studies, prepare technical documentation, and collaborate with engineering, sales, and customer teams to provide expert support on grid connection and modelling topics while contributing to the continuous improvement of Siemens Energy's modelling solutions. How You’ll Make an Impact Ensure timely delivery of models, avoiding project delays and potential penalties. Develop and configure electrical models for customer delivery according to project contractual obligations and deadlines. Prepare technical reports demonstrating compliance with project-specific grid code requirements. Transfer technical knowledge into wind turbine product models delivered to customers. Support internal and external customers regarding simulation & model-related issues. Support Sales during customer meetings and contract negotiations concerning wind turbine electrical systems. Participate in defining and maintaining the company's electrical modelling roadmap. Prepare and maitain documentation, including: design reports, validation reports, user manuals. Generate and/or integrate automatically generated code into the modelling & simulation efforts. Prepare grid code analysis reports for customer projects. Provide generic electrical support regarding wind turbine generator (WTG) capabilities. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical&Electronics Engineering, Control Engineering, or a relevant field.MSc and/or PhD is a strong advantage. Specialization in grid connection of wind power and power system studies. Ideally 5+ years of experience in power systems analysis or similar experience in the educational sector. High level of written and spoken English. Software & Programming Skills: Experience with at least one of the power system simulation tools such as: DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSS®E, PSCAD, EMTP-RV, MATLAB & Simulink. More is a big plus. Expertise on Grid Connection & Power System Studies: Wind farm grid connection, load flow, harmonics, short circuit, dynamic and transient stability studies, and grid code compliance analysis. Expertise on Electrical Engineering & Renewable Energy: Transmission and distribution networks, power electronics, electrical machines, grid interaction (SSR, SSCI, weak grids), wind energy principles, DFIG/full converter technologies, and renewable energy systems (wind, PV, storage). Expertise on Modelling, Simulation & Control: Development and simulation of wind farms, power systems, control algorithms, wind turbine models, renewable power plant controls, and integration of compiled code into simulation tools. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. title: Research, Simulations
description: Employment type: Full time - Hybrid Compensation: 250.000 – 500.000 TL net per month · equity · private health insurance About Talp Talp is simulation infrastructure for enterprise decisions. We build a company’s customer base from its own behavioral data so decisions can be tested before they are made, and we already work with large enterprises across three regions. We are the wind tunnel for decisions. What we install stays and sharpens every time it runs, which is why we call it infrastructure rather than a tool. Testing decisions this way will soon be as ordinary as version control. We have raised $2.2 million to date, most recently at a $25 million valuation, from Formus Capital, Sunshine Lake Ventures, Aito Capital, the a16z Scout Fund, and a group of GPs and founders. The Role Everyone in this field renders the simulation. Nobody renders the proof. Confidence scores, calibration methods, benchmarks measured against human evidence. None of it has been published by anyone in this category, and the company that publishes it first will define how everybody else gets measured. That is the center of this job. You will participate in shaping our scientific direction and turn research into working systems. Your scope spans modeling, evaluation, and the infrastructure that supports experimentation and deployment. This is a hands-on role. You will design experiments, write code, inspect data, and work closely with engineering. You should be comfortable asking difficult scientific questions and taking full responsibility for how they are answered. Responsibilities Shape the research direction: Identify the most valuable questions, prioritize experiments, and connect scientific progress directly to product improvements. Develop and improve models: Work across data preparation, model adaptation, training, and fine-tuning. Reproduce relevant research, challenge its assumptions, and test approaches against strong alternatives. Define how quality is measured: Design benchmarks and experiments that assess behavioral accuracy, consistency, and usefulness. Compare simulations against human evidence while accounting for uncertainty, population variance, and data limitations. Build reliable evaluation systems: Develop repeatable workflows for comparing models, investigating failures, and detecting regressions. Keep datasets, experiments, and results strictly traceable, protecting evaluation data from leaking into development. Combine human and automated judgment: Create clear scoring criteria, review processes, and automated evaluators, then verify that those evaluators consistently agree with qualified human reviewers. Make research practical to run: Partner with engineering on data pipelines, experiment tracking, training workflows, and model serving to maximize iteration speed, reliability, and compute efficiency. Carry improvements into production: Follow promising results through implementation and deployment, verifying that their advantages hold outside the original experiment. Set the scientific standard: Establish clear standards for rigor, and communicate findings through technical writing, publications, and external collaborations. Who You Are Applied Research Record: A strong track record in applied AI or machine learning research, with evidence of taking ideas from experiments into working production systems. Deep Model Experience: Hands-on experience with language models, modern training/fine-tuning techniques, and rigorous model evaluation. Core Engineering Skills: Strong Python skills and deep familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX. Sound Statistical Judgment: You reason intuitively about sampling, uncertainty, and bias, and can tell immediately whether an apparent improvement is statistically meaningful. Systems & Tooling Ownership: Experience building or owning research tooling, evaluation pipelines, or ML infrastructure that other engineers rely on. High Agency: The ability to drive technical work autonomously and make clear decisions even when the empirical evidence is incomplete. Intellectual Honesty: Clear communication and the willingness to discard an approach the moment the data challenges it. Typically five or more years of relevant AI or ML research experience. Relevant academic research counts toward this; we also welcome candidates with exceptional demonstrated impact on a shorter timeline. Valuable Additional Experience Behavioral science, computational social science, causal inference, or experimental design Synthetic data generation, human feedback loops, annotation systems, or complex behavioral datasets Multi-agent systems and simulations involving interacting populations Distributed training, GPU optimization, or efficient model serving You do not need equal depth in every area. title: QA Engineer
description: About AppNation We build AI-powered mobile apps that reach millions of users worldwide. Since 2021, AppNation has been creating products across AI, productivity, and mobile experiences. Our apps, including Genie, Translate AI, and Arch, have reached 90M+ users globally and ranked among the top apps in 30+ countries. We are a team of builders, designers, and engineers who move fast, take ownership, and create products used by millions. About the Role We're looking for a QA Engineer to join Genie Studio and ensure the quality and reliability of Genie, our AI-powered assistant used by millions worldwide. You’ll own testing end-to-end across iOS, Android, and Web, covering AI-powered experiences, revenue-critical flows, releases, and A/B tests. Working closely with Product and Engineering, you’ll combine hands-on testing, automation, and strong user perspective to catch issues early and help us ship reliable experiences at scale. What You’ll Do Own Testing Across Platforms: Plan and execute functional, exploratory and regression testing for Genie on iOS, Android and Web. Test AI-Powered Experiences: Validate chat flows, streamed responses and model updates, and catch quality issues in non-deterministic outputs that traditional test cases miss. Guard Every Release: Run smoke and regression cycles, validate release candidates, and give a clear go/no-go signal for every build. Test Revenue-Critical Flows: Ensure subscriptions, paywalls, trials, renewals and web checkout work correctly across platforms and pricing configurations. Validate A/B Tests: Verify that experiments are set up correctly, users land in the right variants, and each variant behaves and tracks as expected. Detect, Report and Track Bugs: Write clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira, prioritize them with Product and Engineering, and follow them through to verification. Be Part of the Sprint: Join planning and grooming, review requirements early, surface edge cases and risks, and help define acceptance criteria. Automate & Improve: Build and maintain automated tests for web and mobile, keep test plans and regression suites up to date, and drive practical improvements to our QA process and tooling. What We Look For Experience: 3+ years of hands-on QA in consumer mobile and/or web products, ideally in a fast-paced environment. Mobile & Web Testing: Strong experience testing iOS and Android apps and web applications across devices, OS versions and browsers. Release Ownership: Proven experience running regression cycles and validating releases, including App Store and Google Play release processes (TestFlight, internal testing tracks). Subscription & Payment Testing: Hands-on experience with StoreKit and Google Play Billing sandbox environments and/or web payment flows. Technical Skills: Comfortable with API testing (e.g., Postman), reading device logs, network debugging tools (e.g., Charles, Proxyman), Jira and test management tools. Test Automation: Hands-on experience with Playwright, and with Appium or Selenium. Ownership & Communication: Able to work as the sole QA in a team, set your own priorities, make sound quality judgments without close supervision, and communicate risks clearly to Product and Engineering. User Perspective: You think like an end user and care about delivering reliable experiences to millions of people. Nice to Have Experience testing AI/LLM-based products Familiarity with A/B testing tools and analytics event validation Why AppNation? Build and scale products reaching millions of users globally. Work with talented people in a fast-moving AI-first environment. Take ownership and see your impact directly in the products you build. Grow quickly with opportunities to lead projects and shape technical decisions. Enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, including private health insurance, meal and commute support, relocation support, and flexible working options. Our Hiring Process Application Review → Interview → Technical Assessment → Final Interviews At AppNation, we set ambitious goals and challenge ourselves to build products that reach millions of people. We value curiosity, ownership, and continuous growth. If this role excites you and you're ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now—we're excited to meet you.

title: Senior AQA Engineer
description: We are seeking a skilled Senior QA Automation Engineer With 5+ years of experience to join our Gaming Hub team. This role focuses on backend and API testing for player-facing platform services in an iGaming environment. You will design, develop and own automated test solutions that ensure reliable, secure and performant backend systems. Experience in iGaming (or similar real-time/transactional domains) is strongly preferred. Responsibilities Design, develop and maintain automated testing frameworks and scripts focused on backend services and APIs Identify and prioritise test cases for automation (smoke, regression, integration, contract and non-functional) Build and maintain automated API tests, contract tests and integration test suites for microservices and platform components Develop and run performance, load, stress and stability tests; analyse results and drive remediation with engineering teams Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and gating flows; own flakiness reduction and test reliability; and be responsible for test outcome reporting and stakeholder communication Work closely with developers, SREs and product to reproduce, triage and resolve issues; drive observability improvements to aid root-cause analysis Define and maintain test data and environment strategies (sandbox tenants, testing flags, user configuration profiles) Participate in design refinements, feature planning, team ceremonies and product releases Mentor and collaborate with QA peers to raise automation maturity and testing practices Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience Strong experience with automation frameworks and tools for backend/API testing (examples: pytest, Postman/Newman, Cypress, Playwright) Proficient in one or more programming languages used for automation: Python or JavaScript/TypeScript Experience testing RESTful APIs, including contract/schema validation and end-to-end integration testing Familiarity with service virtualisation / mocking tools and containerised test environments; basic knowledge of orchestration (Kubernetes) is a plus Hands-on with CI/CD (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar) and automation integration into pipelines Strong understanding of software testing best practices and methodologies (including test design, flaky test mitigation, CI gating) Knowledge of observability and monitoring tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, New Relic) to validate behaviour in staging/production Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams Excellent problem-solving, analytical and communication skills; fluency in English (written & verbal) Experience designing and executing performance/load tests (k6, JMeter, Locust, or similar) Benefits Private health insurance Company wide social and team building activities Hybrid & Remote work arrangements Flexible working hours Wellbeing day; Training and Development opportunities Logifuture operates across seven countries, with headquarters in Malta and additional offices in the UK (London), Italy (Parma & Lecce), Austria (Innsbruck), Serbia (Kragujevac), Romania (Bucharest) and UAE (Dubai). The majority of our roles listed on our careers page are not restricted by location, giving prospective employees the flexibility to choose any of our offices. Furthermore, we also collaborate with consultants based outside these locations, broadening our talent pool and allowing us to remain agile and competitive in the global market. In addition at Logifuture we embrace equality and diversity. We do not discriminate and our values of delivering results together support this statement. We are determined to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to contribute their unique skills and experiences.

En este puesto, realizarás el análisis de la respuesta mecánica de estructuras bajo cargas extremas, aceleraciones transitorias y fenómenos no lineales. El trabajo consiste en estudiar el comportamiento estructural de los productos de la empresa y el utillaje utilizado en pruebas de ensayo teniendo en cuenta las cargas, la elevada rotación y los problemas asociados a momentos clave de la operativa del producto. Competencias Clave en ANSYS: ANSYS Mechanical / LS-DYNA / Autodyn: Dominio de trabajo de solucionadores explícitos (explicit dynamics) para problemas de choque, impacto, penetración o altas aceleraciones. Modelado de Materiales No Lineales: Manejo de modelos de plasticidad dependiente de la tasa de deformación (ej. Johnson-Cook), criterios de fallo/daño, hiperelasticidad y gran deformación. Contactos Complejos: Configuración de contactos no lineales (fricción, erosión de elementos, autodetección de contacto en malla deformada). Transitorios Térmicos y Termomecánicos: Análisis de acoplamiento térmico-estructural transitorio (gradientes térmicos severos, tensiones térmicas) Para abordar con éxito los casos multifísicos acoplados (FSI o Fluid-Structure Interaction), deseable: Manejo de ANSYS System Coupling / Workbench: Definir interfaces de transferencia de datos (cargas aerodinámicas/presiones > estructura, desplazamientos > malla CFD, campos de temperatura > tensiones térmicas). CFD estacionario/transitorio exportado como carga térmica o de presión a Mechanical) o bidireccional (two-way, transitorio acoplado paso a paso para aeroelasticidad o flutter). Infraestructura HPC: Conocimientos prácticos en configuración de licencias, particionado de malla y paralelización en entornos de supercomputación/clusters para simulación intensiva. Ubicación: Presencialidad en Via de Dublin, Madrid. QUÉ DEBE APORTAR Máster o Grado en Ingeniería Aeronáutica, Mecánica o Industrial Al menos 3 años de experiencia en análisis dinámico no lineal. Inglés B2 Necesario. title: Junior Beräkningsingenjör Linköping

Som medarbetare hos oss behöver du snabbt kunna sätta dig in i nya sammanhang och läsa in dig på nya tekniker om så behövs. Som person är du engagerad, ödmjuk och en genuin lagspelare som trivs med att arbeta i team där ni tillsammans uppnår goda resultat. Då kan vi erbjuda dig karriärmöjligheter på en modern arbetsplats med utmanande arbetsuppgifter och spännande projekt världen över. AFRY är rankat som en av Sveriges mest populära arbetsgivare bland ingenjörer. Hos oss är du med och utvecklar innovativa och hållbara lösningar inom infrastruktur, energi och industri. title: Ingénieur(e) calcul en mécanique des structures H/F/D F/H
description: Travaillant au sein de l’équipe « Technology » de l’ingénierie Produit, l’ingénieur(e) calcul pour l’intégrité mécanique devra réaliser des études statiques et dynamiques des composants et assemblages des produits nucléaires, et contribuera au développement des outils et méthodes associés. Les produits nucléaires incluent la turbine à vapeur, les échangeurs thermiques, l’alternateur, les pompes et leurs systèmes auxiliaires. Ce rôle consiste principalement à évaluer l’intégrité mécanique de produits nucléaires (turbine, alternateur, pompes, échangeurs de chaleur, etc.) et à développer des méthodes et outils pour les analyses d’intégrité mécanique statique, dynamique et thermomécanique. Les principales activités sont les suivantes : Réaliser des analyses d’intégrité mécanique par la méthode des éléments finis sur des composants, conformément aux critères de dimensionnement et aux règles et instructions internes. Modéliser des structures complexes à l’aide du logiciel de maillage HyperMesh et effectuer des simulations par éléments finis sous ANSYS. Personnaliser les modèles, automatiser les cas de charge et effectuer des post-traitements avancés à l’aide du langage APDL (Ansys Parametric Design Language). Réaliser des analyses statiques et dynamiques (modales, sismiques, harmoniques, transitoires), ainsi que des études de durée de vie (fatigue, nocivité, propagation de fissures). Effectuer des calculs mécaniques linéaires et non linéaires (non-linéarités de contact, de comportement matériau et de géométrie). Intégrer les exigences des codes (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M) dans les études de dimensionnement des appareils à pression. Prendre en charge les analyses mécaniques dans le cadre de l’exécution des projets et/ou du développement produit. Rédiger les rapports d’analyse d’intégrité mécanique conformément aux exigences qualité et aux plannings définis. Vérifier les calculs et analyses réalisés par d’autres membres de l’équipe. Assurer le suivi technique des activités sous-traitées. Contribuer au développement et à l’harmonisation des outils, processus de calcul et à la capitalisation du savoir-faire. Respecter les règles et instructions EHS propres à l’entreprise. Diplôme d’ingénieur ou doctorat dans le domaine du calcul d’intégrité mécanique. Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine du calcul mécanique de structures par éléments finis. Excellente maîtrise des outils ANSYS (APDL) et HyperMesh ; la connaissance de CATIA est un atout. Bonne connaissance des codes et standards applicables aux appareils à pression (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M). Connaissance des machines tournantes Capacité à lire, analyser et interpréter des plans de fabrication et des documents d’ingénierie. Aptitude à travailler dans un environnement motivant et exigeant. Leadership et capacité à piloter des activités techniques complexes. Bon relationnel, esprit d’équipe et capacité à représenter le service dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et international. Disponibilité pour des déplacements occasionnels en France ou à l’étranger (principalement en Europe). Bon niveau d’anglais.

title: Structures Analysis Engineer, Launch Vehicle Structure (m/f/d)
description: Mission Brief You will be responsible for the structural analysis of entire assemblies belonging to our rocket’s primary and secondary structures. From trading design concepts to sizing and validating design iterations and examining the impact of manufacturing deviations, you will play an important role in guiding design decisions and pushing performance and reliability of our structures forward. As a Mid-Level Structures Analysis Engineer, you will support the analysis, verification and development of launch vehicle structures throughout the entire lifecycle, from concept to qualification. Your Role in Our Space Mission: Perform detailed stress analysis of aerospace structures and components using both classical hand calculations and advanced finite element methods (FEM), mostly of CFRP structures. Identify failure scenarios and collaborate with design engineers to review and optimize structural designs. Define applicable load cases, addressing the impact of thermal, quasi-static loads (arising from random vibrations) etc. Analise and provide possible solutions to manufacturing non-conformities. Develop test plans and support physical testing of components to verify sizing assumptions and qualify hardware. Prepare comprehensive stress analysis reports and documentation for internal/external use. Improve our standards and toolchain for structural verification. Be familiar with classical design standards and have experience in the use of CAD software Operate independently with moderate guidance. Qualification Checklist Degree in the field of Engineering, Aerospace, Mechanical or (Computational) Mechanics, or any other related field. At least 3 years of experience in analysing aerospace structures. Good knowledge in classical hand-calculations and advanced FE Modelling of aerospace structures (Hypermesh, Optistruct, Nastran etc). Self-motivated, collaborative, and capable of working independently with moderate guidance. Good engineering intuition with regards to load paths and failure mechanisms. Strong teamwork skills to contribute to team goals and support large projects, including interaction with other departments. Fluent English Bonus Skills Practical experience in the space sector (preferably in launch vehicle development program). Previous experience using CAD, preferably with Siemens NX. Good understanding of composite structures’ behaviour over a wide range of temperatures. Practical experience with Material Qualification and composite manufacturing techniques. Experience with winding & draping of carbon fibre (design or hands-on) Knowledge in quality standards, specifications and procedures around CFRP components German language skills Benefits Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program 30 days of vacation: Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge Company pension plan: Secure your future with our company pension plan, featuring a 20% employer contribution after the probation period Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day Public transport ticket: Commute with ease using a fully financed Deutschlandticket Rental clothing with laundry service: Enjoy hassle-free workwear with our convenient rental clothing and laundry service Sport Clubs membership: Stay fit with our sponsored sports club memberships (EGYM Wellpass) Individual learning allowance: Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the probation period Childcare allowance: Receive a childcare allowance for your non-school-age children And Much More! title: Process Engineer
description: At Materialise Medical, we believe that better healthcare starts with solutions designed around the individual patient. If you’re passionate about bringing personalized care to every patient, you’ll love being a part of this team. Through the technology we develop, researchers, engineers, and clinicians are revolutionizing personalized treatment — helping improve and save lives daily. To further drive & support our Medical Production activities Materialise Medical is looking for a Process Engineer to join the HQ Process Engineering team (Leuven). What You Will Be Doing You will be stepping into a cross-functional agile team which focuses on CMF product development as well as manufacturing process development and implementation. With your strong engineering mindset, you develop thorough expertise in additive manufacturing, post-processing, cleaning and quality inspection technologies, allowing you to become the technical expert and GoTo for both development & operational questions. Next to that, you also gain a solid understanding of CMF product specifics, enabling you to effectively connect product requirements to the corresponding process needs. You take the lead in managing and driving larger process development, implementation and validation projects, ensuring alignment across different teams and timely delivery of results. You are involved early in the development of new or updated devices, assessing manufacturability and process validation needs. In close collaboration with the device development team, you assist in the definition of a clear and comprehensive set of product specifications which will serve as input for the process validation and implementation after design transfer. You own the validation programs for the manufacturing processes and corresponding equipment. You create these validation programs from scratch for new products and processes or update them for each product and process change, after which you execute (or coordinate the execution of) the corresponding equipment validations (IQOQPQ). Where required for process or product changes, you set up, execute and analyze process characterization studies to understand the impact of process parameters on process and product output. You continuously evaluate process performance and identify opportunities to standardize, streamline and automate process steps, contributing to operational excellence and scalability. You drive process development and operational roll-out of various process changes and translate this into operational success by providing the right process documentation, including work instructions, operator training and support. You guarantee compliance with Quality Management System requirements by meticulously documenting all phases of the process characterization, validation and operational implementation per internal quality procedures. As a member of the Process Engineering team, you will enjoy close cooperation with stakeholders from operational, device development, biosafety, research, quality and regulatory teams. Through involvement in a variety of activities and projects, we set up a growth trajectory in which you can shape your own future within Materialise. Your profile You have a master’s degree in engineering You have at least 2 years of experience working in a process (validation) engineering role within highly regulated industries such as the medical devices, pharmaceuticals or aerospace industries. Experience with Design Transfer activities and/or Additive Manufacturing is considered a strong plus You are quality oriented and have an eye for detail, but you also don’t get stuck on this. You are able to think out of the box when needed You are good at troubleshooting and problem solving You have a strong and versatile work ethic and you’re eager to learn You are proactive and self-organized. You take initiative and demonstrate full ownership of your tasks. You value and uphold impeccable coordination Strong English verbal & written skills required Note: A motivation letter is requested when applying for this position. description: Does the idea of using your mechanical expertise to help build the world’s largest pharmaceutical facilities excite you? And do you thrive on tackling complex challenges and developing with each new task in a dynamic project environment? Then you’ll fit right in! Who We Are We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere. Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you. About The Role We are looking for newly graduated mechanical engineers, marine engineers or related educational backgrounds to ensure that our customers get the best-in-class mechanical consultancy in their projects ranging from conceptual design up until installation and commissioning. You will be a part of a highly skilled and supportive team of more than 280 colleagues across our 8 mechanical departments where you will work on large-scale projects currently in the production phase that will challenge and develop your skills. Why do we need you? Our aim is to assist our customers in establishing efficient, sustainable and intelligent facilities for API production. Your role will be crucial in delivering top-notch mechanical consultancy, ensuring our customers receive the best possible service. It is therefore essential that you have the ability to gain a broad understanding of mechanical engineering principles and to have a keen interest in the pharmaceutical industry to excel in this role Location Denmark - Kalundborg Experience Graduate level Department Mechanical KA II How You Might Spend Your Days As a newly graduated Mechanical Engineer, you’ll be: Specifying and dimensioning mechanical equipment, piping systems and technical components Supporting installation, construction and commissioning activities on large-scale pharmaceutical projects Participating in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) Collaborating with contractors, suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams Contributing to technical assessments and problem-solving throughout project execution Who You Are We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are: Thrive in a dynamic project environment where priorities can evolve as projects progress Communicate clearly with colleagues, customers and stakeholders Take a structured and organised approach to your work Are curious and motivated to continuously learn and develop your technical skills Are positive, resilient and solution-oriented when facing challenges What You Bring To The Role In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role: You have recently graduated, or expect to graduate within the next six months, with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or a related technical discipline Through studies, projects, hobbies or practical experience, you have developed an interest in mechanical equipment and technical systems You are comfortable working in a highly regulated environment where quality, documentation and traceability are key You are fluent in written and spoken English Life at NNE NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more. At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. You can read more about the benefits we offer here . Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you. Deadline of application is 15 October 2026 Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact on or Lars Lundberg Kristensen at +45 3075 8534. Please note: We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV We invite to interviews on a running basis. Fair hiring At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. title: Junior mechanical engineer
description: Ontwerp wat beweegt, tilt en draait Als junior mechanical engineer werk je aan techniek die letterlijk in beweging is. Denk aan containerkranen van honderd meter hoog, het beweegbare dak van de Johan Cruijff ArenA of offshore windplatforms midden op zee. Jij ontwerpt en rekent aan onderdelen die onder zware omstandigheden moeten blijven functioneren. Binnen infra en water werk je aan beweegbare bruggen, sluizen, gemalen en waterzuiveringen. Je ontwerpt aandrijvingen en bewegingswerken die elke dag betrouwbaar moeten functioneren. In offshoreprojecten werk je aan hijsvoorzieningen en mechanische onderdelen van windplatforms. Binnen de industrie ontwerp je constructies voor fabrieken en procesinstallaties. En in de maritieme sector werk je mee aan de mechanica van onderzeeboten en marineschepen. Je werkt ontwerpen uit van concept tot detail. Je maakt berekeningen op sterkte, stijfheid en vermoeiing, toetst aan normen en denkt mee over maakbaarheid en onderhoud. Je stemt af met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines zoals civiele techniek, elektrotechniek en procestechnologie. Je ziet hoe jouw ontwerp onderdeel wordt van een groter geheel. Bij Iv werken we aan projecten die anderen soms voor onmogelijk houden. We houden van ingewikkelde vraagstukken, maar niet van moeilijk doen. De lijnen zijn kort, de lat ligt hoog en je krijgt snel verantwoordelijkheid. Je start met begeleiding, maar groeit snel door naar zelfstandige taken. Wil je je verdiepen in ontwerp, modelleren of juist richting projectcoördinatie? Dan krijg je daar de ruimte voor. Jouw ambitie bepaalt je route. Wat verwachten we van jou? Hbo- of wo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde Interesse in maritiem, offshore, gebouwen of infraprojecten Analytisch sterk en zorgvuldig Goede communicatieve vaardigheden Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands Wat hebben we jou te bieden? Een uitdagende en gevarieerde baan bij het meest diverse ingenieursbureau van Nederland! Zo kun je rekenen op: De gaafste projecten in alle sectoren: je werkt aan hoogwaardige oplossingen waar de maatschappij écht iets aan heeft. Van ’s werelds grootste offshore windplatformen, bruggen en sluizen tot fabrieken, waterzuiveringsinstallaties en onderzeeboten. Een professionele én gezellige werkomgeving: bij Iv vind je een laagdrempelige werksfeer waarin hard werken hand in hand gaat met plezier. Zo bezoeken we tweejaarlijks het EK- of WK-voetbal, vieren we nieuwjaar groots in de Efteling, organiseren we gezellige zomerbarbecues en nog veel meer! Flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden: kies voor meer salaris, extra vakantiedagen of beide! Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden: 31 vakantiedagen, jaarlijkse gratificatie (7%), winstuitkering, flexibele pensioenregeling en reiskosten- en thuiswerkvergoeding. Ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden: we bieden talloze mogelijkheden tot het volgen van opleidingen, cursussen en trainingen om nóg beter te worden in je vak. Kortom: bij Iv werk je samen met 1400 andere specialisten aan de grootste uitdagingen van deze tijd én beleef je veel plezier. Dat noemen wij: engineering that excites.

title: Graduate Mechanical Engineer
description: Description Designer Group is seeking Graduate Mechanical Engineers to join our growing teams, with multiple positions available for immediate start . This is an excellent opportunity for recent Mechanical Engineering graduates who want to build a career with a leading international mechanical and electrical contractor. You will gain hands-on experience across live projects, working alongside experienced engineers, project teams, commercial teams and site leadership. As a Graduate Mechanical Engineer, you will support the delivery of mechanical building services across a range of projects, which may include commercial, industrial, pharmaceutical, data centre, residential, energy and infrastructure environments. You will be exposed to both office-based and site-based work, giving you a strong practical understanding of how mechanical systems are designed, coordinated, installed, tested and commissioned. Designer Group’s graduate programme is designed to support early-career professionals through practical project experience, mentoring, structured development and exposure to major engineering projects across Ireland, the UK and Europe. The existing graduate programme is positioned as a two-year programme providing hands-on experience across core teams and project environments. Key Responsibilities Will Include Supporting project teams with the delivery of mechanical services from early-stage planning through to installation, testing and commissioning. Assisting with technical reviews, drawings, specifications, submittals and project documentation. Working with engineers, supervisors, subcontractors and site teams to support safe and efficient project delivery. Supporting quality, safety and compliance requirements across mechanical works. Assisting with progress tracking, reporting, materials coordination and issue resolution. Developing practical knowledge of M&E contracting, construction sequencing, programme requirements and client expectations. Building your technical understanding of mechanical systems, site coordination, project delivery and engineering best practice. Participating in training, mentoring and continuous professional development as part of your graduate journey. Requirements Requirements Minimum Requirements Level 7 or Level 8 qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline. Strong interest in mechanical building services, M&E contracting and construction project delivery. Good communication, organisation and problem-solving skills. Ability to work well as part of a team and take direction from experienced engineers and project leaders. Proactive attitude, strong work ethic and willingness to learn. Comfortable working in both office and site-based environments. Available to start immediately or at short notice. Preferred But Not Essential Previous placement, internship or site experience within construction, M&E, building services, utilities, energy, pharma, commercial or data centre environments. Basic understanding of mechanical drawings, schematics, technical specifications or construction documentation. Exposure to AutoCAD, Revit, BIM, Microsoft Project, Excel or other engineering/project tools. Interest in progressing toward professional development, CPD and chartership. Benefits Benefits At Designer Group, our people are central to our continued growth. We invest in graduates through structured development, mentoring and exposure to real project delivery from the beginning of their careers. Benefits Include Full-time permanent employment. Structured graduate development. Mentoring from experienced engineering professionals. Exposure to major M&E projects. Pathway to chartership. CPD training, including Engineers Ireland-accredited development. International project opportunities. Competitive salary. Pension plan. Health plan. Life cover. Travel and subsistence allowances where applicable. Bike to Work scheme. Social committee and employee events. Third-level education grant support. Designer Group is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: About Osbit: We’re Osbit. We design and build cutting-edge engineering systems to make offshore wind happen at scale. We supply engineering equipment across many technology areas, to enable key offshore operations such as wind turbine foundation installation, burial and installation of subsea cables, and the lifting & handling of wind turbine components. We’re here to redefine what’s possible offshore, to drive the clean energy sector, and our planet, forward. We combine decades of collective experience in developing offshore equipment with fresh and innovative approaches, and we are passionate about enabling a more sustainable world for us all. We're proud to be a formative member company in game-changing offshore wind services business Venterra Group. Role Description: This role is the sturdy foundation underpinning Osbit’s success. An Osbit Mechanical Engineer is technically capable, and driven, in equal measure. You're an energetic all-rounder, owning your project from start to finish, and collaborating closely with your colleagues to overcome any obstacles thrown your way. The offshore wind industry is growing fast, and our projects are too. There’s lots to work on, with opportunities to take ownership and make a genuine difference to our business outcomes. You must be willing to get stuck in, combining your technical nous with strong communication, and lateral thinking, to ensure that we deliver On Spec, to Budget and In Time - OSBIT, every time. Your Responsibilities: You'll be part of a live project team, working closely with your teammates to design and build each engineering system. You may be assigned different roles project-to-project, and your core responsibilities include: Helping design innovative systems from first principles, from concept through to detailed design, while maintaining technical excellence. Supporting on schedule delivery by effective management of your project deliverables. Managing supplier progress, holding regular meetings and in-person support. Preparing technical documentation & design calculations for peer review, and checking third party documentation. Preparing for and carrying out testing, commissioning and mobilisation activities. Liaising with other business functions, including finance and HSSEQ, for support and guidance. Supporting your teammates by sharing your knowledge and insights in working groups and presentations, where applicable. About You: Open minded with a keen to learn attitude. First rate communicator. Self-motivated and persistent in getting from A to B. Diligent in attention to detail. Adaptable when unexpected challenges crop up. Your Experience: We welcome a range of qualification levels, from graduates onwards. In this role, as a basis you'll need: A degree-level qualification, or equivalent, in a technical field, such as Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Engineering, or Naval Architecture. The ability to work with Autodesk Inventor software. Proficiency in hand calculations, through to Staad and FEA. Further Information: Successful applicants be based at our Netherlands headquarters, in Rotterdam, working on site as required. Working abroad may be required at times to visit customers, suppliers, and support assembly programmes. We can offer hybrid working in this role. What we offer: It's really important to us that Osbit is a fun and supportive place to be. This is why we offer a range of benefits. In the Netherlands, these include: Company pension scheme. Opportunities to take part in UK inhouse training. Lunch and refreshments provided daily. Access to a UK Myers Briggs practitioner & counsellor, and tailored coaching. Annual summer party celebration and Christmas walk, lunch, and festivities. About Venterra Group: Venterra Group is a dedicated wind energy services group at the forefront of driving the clean energy transition. Together, we engineer, build and support the operations of major wind developments around the world by providing specialist, technical and comprehensive services at every stage of the project lifecycle. Our vision is to become the global services champion and strategic partner supporting the wind industry’s rapid expansion. At Venterra, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected and valued. We believe that diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives make us stronger and help us achieve better outcomes. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to succeed and thrive.
